items.title_en: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
items.abstract_en: Deeper neural networks are more difficult to train. We present a residual learning framework to ease the training of networks that are substantially deeper than those used previously. We explicitly reformulate the layers as learning residual functions with reference to the layer inputs, instead of learning unreferenced functions. We provide comprehensive empirical evidence showing that these residual networks are easier to optimize, and can gain accuracy from considerably increased depth. On the ImageNet dataset we evaluate residual nets with a depth of up to 152 layers---8x deeper than VGG nets but still having lower complexity. An ensemble of these residual nets achieves 3.57% error on the ImageNet test set. This result won the 1st place on the ILSVRC 2015 classification task. We also present analysis on CIFAR-10 with 100 and 1000 layers. The depth of representations is of central importance for many visual recognition tasks. Solely due to our extremely deep representations, we obtain a 28% relative improvement on the COCO object detection dataset. Deep residual nets are foundations of our submissions to ILSVRC & COCO 2015 competitions, where we also won the 1st places on the tasks of ImageNet detection, ImageNet localization, COCO detection, and COCO segmentation.

items.title_zh: 用于图像识别的深度残差学习
items.abstract_zh: 更深的神经网络更难训练。我们提出残差学习框架，将网络层显式改写为以该层输入为参照的残差函数，而非学习无参照的函数，从而降低极深网络的训练难度。大量实验表明，残差网络更易优化，并能从显著增加的深度中获得精度提升。在 ImageNet 上，深达 152 层的残差网络比 VGG 深 8 倍而复杂度更低，其集成模型在测试集上取得 3.57% 错误率，赢得 ILSVRC 2015 分类任务第一名；我们还在 CIFAR-10 上分析了 100 层与 1000 层的网络。仅凭极深的表征，COCO 目标检测即获得 28% 的相对提升。
items.highlight_zh: 残差连接让 152 层网络易训练并夺得 ImageNet 冠军
items.digest_zh:
• 研究问题：网络越深，表达力越强；但简单堆叠层数会出现“退化”：训练误差反而上升，优化困难。
• 方法：作者提出残差学习，让模块学习输入与输出之间的差值 F(x)，再用跳跃连接把输入 x 加回输出，即让网络拟合 F(x)+x。这样网络只需学“相对输入的改动”，恒等映射变得容易，梯度也能沿捷径直接回传。
• 结果：在 ImageNet 上训练 152 层残差网络，深度是 VGG 的 8 倍而计算量更低；多模型集成在测试集上错误率 3.57%，夺得 ILSVRC 2015 分类第一。CIFAR-10 上验证 100 层乃至 1000 层网络仍可训练并获益。仅靠更深特征，COCO 目标检测相对提升 28%。
• 为何重要：残差连接解开了深层网络的训练死结，使“很深”真正可用，此后成为视觉乃至众多领域深度网络的默认结构组件。

items.title_en: Highly accurate protein structure prediction with AlphaFold
items.abstract_en: Abstract Proteins are essential to life, and understanding their structure can facilitate a mechanistic understanding of their function. Through an enormous experimental effort 1–4 , the structures of around 100,000 unique proteins have been determined 5 , but this represents a small fraction of the billions of known protein sequences 6,7 . Structural coverage is bottlenecked by the months to years of painstaking effort required to determine a single protein structure. Accurate computational approaches are needed to address this gap and to enable large-scale structural bioinformatics. Predicting the three-dimensional structure that a protein will adopt based solely on its amino acid sequence—the structure prediction component of the ‘protein folding problem’ 8 —has been an important open research problem for more than 50 years 9 . Despite recent progress 10–14 , existing methods fall far short of atomic accuracy, especially when no homologous structure is available. Here we provide the first computational method that can regularly predict protein structures with atomic accuracy even in cases in which no similar structure is known. We validated an entirely redesigned version of our neural network-based model, AlphaFold, in the challenging 14th Critical Assessment of protein Structure Prediction (CASP14) 15 , demonstrating accuracy competitive with experimental structures in a majority of cases and greatly outperforming other methods. Underpinning the latest version of AlphaFold is a novel machine learning approach that incorporates physical and biological knowledge about protein structure, leveraging multi-sequence alignments, into the design of the deep learning algorithm.

items.title_zh: 用 AlphaFold 实现高精度蛋白质结构预测
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质对生命至关重要，理解其结构有助于从机制上认识其功能。经巨大的实验努力，约 10 万种独特蛋白质的结构已被测定，但这只占已知数十亿条蛋白质序列的极小部分，瓶颈在于测定单个结构往往需数月到数年。仅凭氨基酸序列预测蛋白质三维结构——“蛋白质折叠问题”的结构预测部分——五十多年来一直是重要的开放难题。现有方法远未达到原子级精度，尤其在没有同源结构时。我们提出首个能在无相似结构可用时也常以原子精度预测结构的计算方法：完全重新设计的神经网络模型 AlphaFold 在 CASP14 评估中多数情况下精度可与实验结构媲美，并大幅优于其他方法，其关键在于把关于蛋白质结构的物理与生物知识（多序列比对）融入深度学习算法设计。
items.highlight_zh: AlphaFold 首次在无同源结构时达到接近原子级精度
items.digest_zh:
• 研究问题：蛋白质功能由三维结构决定，但实验测定（X 射线晶体学、冷冻电镜等）一个结构常需数月到数年；已知序列有数十亿条，已解结构仅约十万个，缺口巨大。仅凭序列预测结构已悬置五十余年。
• 方法：AlphaFold 用深度神经网络直接从氨基酸序列预测原子的三维坐标，把多序列比对（同源序列中的进化共变信息）以及关于蛋白质结构的物理与生物先验嵌入算法设计与训练之中，模型经过彻底重新设计。
• 结果：在 CASP14 盲测中，多数目标上的预测精度与实验结构相当，大幅超越其他参赛方法，尤其是在没有已知相似结构可用时首次达到接近原子级精度。
• 为何重要：这使大规模结构生物信息学成为可能，把“结构决定功能”的分析从少数已解结构推广到蛋白质组尺度，对基础生物学与药物设计影响深远。

items.title_en: All-Optical Machine Learning Using Diffractive Deep Neural Networks
items.abstract_en: We introduce an all-optical Diffractive Deep Neural Network (D2NN) architecture that can learn to implement various functions after deep learning-based design of passive diffractive layers that work collectively. We experimentally demonstrated the success of this framework by creating 3D-printed D2NNs that learned to implement handwritten digit classification and the function of an imaging lens at terahertz spectrum. With the existing plethora of 3D-printing and other lithographic fabrication methods as well as spatial-light-modulators, this all-optical deep learning framework can perform, at the speed of light, various complex functions that computer-based neural networks can implement, and will find applications in all-optical image analysis, feature detection and object classification, also enabling new camera designs and optical components that can learn to perform unique tasks using D2NNs.

items.title_zh: 使用衍射深度神经网络的全光机器学习
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种全光衍射深度神经网络（D2NN）架构：经深度学习设计的一组无源衍射层协同工作，可学会实现各种功能。我们在太赫兹波段用 3D 打印的 D2NN 实验演示了该框架，使其学会手写数字分类并实现成像透镜的功能。借助现有丰富的 3D 打印、光刻与空间光调制器手段，该全光深度学习框架能以光速完成计算机神经网络可实现的多种复杂功能，并将在全光图像分析、特征检测与目标分类中得到应用，还能催生可学习执行独特任务的新型相机与光学元件。
items.highlight_zh: 用 3D 打印衍射层让光以光速完成神经网络推理
items.digest_zh:
• 研究问题：常规神经网络依赖电子计算，能耗与时延受限；能否让光本身“计算”，用无源光学元件完成分类等任务？
• 方法：把多层衍射面（每层具有可设计的相位与振幅图案）当作网络的一层层“权重”，光在各层之间的自由空间传播相当于层间连接。先用计算机按深度学习（误差反传）训练这些层的参数，再用 3D 打印制造实体器件，在太赫兹波段搭建 D2NN。
• 结果：实验中，3D 打印的 D2NN 实现了手写数字分类，并实现了一个成像透镜的功能，验证了“训练—加工—推理”的可行路径。
• 为何重要：推理以光速、近乎无源地完成，适合全光图像分析、特征检测与目标分类，还可能催生能“学习”执行特定任务的新型相机与光学元件；随着 3D 打印、光刻与空间光调制器成熟，其扩展性可观。

items.title_en: XGBoost: A Scalable Tree Boosting System
items.abstract_en: Tree boosting is a highly effective and widely used machine learning method. In this paper, we describe a scalable end-to-end tree boosting system called XGBoost, which is used widely by data scientists to achieve state-of-the-art results on many machine learning challenges. We propose a novel sparsity-aware algorithm for sparse data and weighted quantile sketch for approximate tree learning. More importantly, we provide insights on cache access patterns, data compression and sharding to build a scalable tree boosting system. By combining these insights, XGBoost scales beyond billions of examples using far fewer resources than existing systems.

items.title_zh: XGBoost：一个可扩展的树提升系统
items.abstract_zh: 树提升是一种极为有效且广泛使用的机器学习方法。本文介绍可扩展的端到端树提升系统 XGBoost，它被数据科学家广泛用于在众多机器学习挑战中取得当前最优结果。我们提出面向稀疏数据的稀疏感知算法，以及用于近似树学习的加权分位数草图；更重要的是，我们给出了关于缓存访问模式、数据压缩与分片的洞见，用以构建可扩展的树提升系统。综合这些设计，XGBoost 在资源远少于现有系统的情况下，可扩展到数十亿样本以上。
items.highlight_zh: 稀疏感知算法与系统优化让树提升扩展到十亿级样本
items.digest_zh:
• 研究问题：梯度提升树精度高、用途广，但面对超大规模数据与稀疏特征时，现有系统在速度、内存与可扩展性上受限。
• 方法：XGBoost 作为端到端系统，提出稀疏感知的分裂查找算法（为缺失值自动学习默认分支方向，只处理非缺失部分），用加权分位数草图在近似学习中高效寻找分裂点；并借助列块存储、缓存友好的访问模式、数据压缩与分片等工程手段，支持分布式与核外计算。
• 结果：综合这些设计，系统在资源远少于同类的情况下可扩展到数十亿样本，成为当时众多机器学习竞赛获胜方案的基础。
• 为何重要：它把统计上表现优异的模型与工程上可扩展的实现结合起来，成为表格数据建模的事实标准之一，也启发了后续梯度提升系统的设计思路。

items.title_en: Gamer: A Generalist Vision-Language-Action Foundation Model for Long-Horizon Real-Time Game Agent
items.title_zh: Gamer：面向长时程实时游戏智能体的通用视觉-语言-动作基础模型
items.abstract_en: We introduce Gamer, a generalist agent framework built for long-horizon tasks in complex interactive environments. Its end-to-end architecture combines perception, memory management, and multi-step reasoning. A shared training and deployment pipeline supports interaction with both conventional 2D graphical interfaces and complex 3D simulated worlds. We first continue pre-training on a dataset constructed from tens of thousands of hours of device-level keyboard and mouse interaction. These trajectories span simulated games and embodied environments, allowing the model to learn environmental dynamics across both physical and virtual domains. Sparse-thinking instruction tuning then substantially reduces redundant computation while preserving the reasoning needed for complex decisions. We train the policy for long-horizon interaction with a stable multi-turn reinforcement learning method that addresses finite context windows, accumulated rollout errors, and sparse rewards. For real-time interaction, a cloud-edge inference engine serves numerous simulated game environments concurrently, supports unbounded-context execution, and keeps online inference latency low. Across multiple challenging 3D open-world games, Gamer demonstrates solid generalization and operational efficiency comparable to skilled players. It also achieves competitive results on a range of conventional 2D game benchmarks. These results suggest that even repetitive keyboard and mouse trajectories can support substantial gains from scaling data and learning algorithms. Training on these trajectories helps Gamer learn complex skills more steadily in environments with both physical and digital properties. This approach offers a path toward generalist agents that can interact across digital and physical worlds.
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出 Gamer，一个面向复杂交互环境中长时程任务的通用智能体框架。其端到端架构融合感知、记忆管理与多步推理，同一套训练与部署流程既可对接传统 2D 图形界面，也可对接复杂 3D 仿真世界。作者首先用数万小时设备级键盘鼠标交互轨迹进行持续预训练，这些轨迹覆盖模拟游戏与具身环境，使模型学习物理与虚拟两类环境的动态规律；随后采用稀疏思考指令微调，在保留复杂决策所需推理的同时大幅减少冗余计算。针对长时程交互，作者用稳定的多轮强化学习方法训练策略，以应对有限上下文窗口、累积的 rollout 误差与稀疏奖励问题。实时交互方面，云边协同推理引擎可并发服务大量仿真游戏环境，支持无界上下文执行并保持较低在线延迟。在多个高难度 3D 开放世界游戏中，Gamer 表现出与熟练玩家相当的泛化能力与运行效率，并在多种传统 2D 游戏基准上取得有竞争力的结果。研究表明，即便是重复性的键鼠轨迹，也能通过数据与算法规模化带来显著收益。

items.title_en: ORB-SLAM3: An Accurate Open-Source Library for Visual, Visual-Inertial and Multi-Map SLAM
items.abstract_en: This paper presents ORB-SLAM3, the first system able to perform visual, visual-inertial and multi-map SLAM with monocular, stereo and RGB-D cameras, using pin-hole and fisheye lens models. The first main novelty is a feature-based tightly-integrated visual-inertial SLAM system that fully relies on Maximum-a-Posteriori (MAP) estimation, even during the IMU initialization phase. The result is a system that operates robustly in real-time, in small and large, indoor and outdoor environments, and is 2 to 5 times more accurate than previous approaches. The second main novelty is a multiple map system that relies on a new place recognition method with improved recall. Thanks to it, ORB-SLAM3 is able to survive to long periods of poor visual information: when it gets lost, it starts a new map that will be seamlessly merged with previous maps when revisiting mapped areas. Compared with visual odometry systems that only use information from the last few seconds, ORB-SLAM3 is the first system able to reuse in all the algorithm stages all previous information. This allows to include in bundle adjustment co-visible keyframes, that provide high parallax observations boosting accuracy, even if they are widely separated in time or if they come from a previous mapping session. Our experiments show that, in all sensor configurations, ORB-SLAM3 is as robust as the best systems available in the literature, and significantly more accurate. Notably, our stereo-inertial SLAM achieves an average accuracy of 3.6 cm on the EuRoC drone and 9 mm under quick hand-held motions in the room of TUM-VI dataset, a setting representative of AR/VR scenarios. For the benefit of the community we make public the source code.

items.title_zh: ORB-SLAM3：面向视觉、视觉惯性与多地图 SLAM 的高精度开源库
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出 ORB-SLAM3，这是首个能在单目、双目与 RGB-D 相机以及针孔和鱼眼镜头模型下，同时完成视觉、视觉惯性与多地图 SLAM 的系统。第一个创新是基于特征的紧耦合视觉惯性 SLAM，即使在 IMU 初始化阶段也完全依赖最大后验（MAP）估计，因而能在室内外大小场景中实时稳健运行，精度较此前方法高 2 至 5 倍。第二个创新是多地图系统，其依赖一种召回率更高的新地点识别方法：当视觉信息长期贫乏而丢失跟踪时，系统会新建地图，并在重访已建图区域时与旧地图无缝合并。与仅利用最近几秒信息的视觉里程计不同，ORB-SLAM3 是首个在所有算法环节复用全部历史信息的系统，可将时间上相隔很远或来自此前建图会话的共视关键帧纳入光束法平差，从而获得大视差观测、提升精度。实验表明，在各传感器配置下其稳健性均与现有最佳系统相当，且精度显著更高；双目惯性配置在 EuRoC 无人机数据上平均精度 3.6 厘米，在 TUM-VI 快速手持场景下为 9 毫米。代码已开源。

items.title_en: DySENSE: Dynamic Spatiotemporal ENergy Synthesis and Emulation with Satellite Imagery
items.title_zh: DySENSE：基于卫星影像的动态时空能源合成与仿真
items.abstract_en: Cities account for over two-thirds of the world's energy and more than 70% of global carbon dioxide emissions. City energy is essential for achieving the 2050 net-zero target and the UN's Sustainable Development Goals 7 and 11. Although existing studies have made progress, they are limited by data and methodological gaps. Existing studies are largely predictive for existing cities rather than generative for future cities; fine-grained, aligned monthly dynamic energy data are scarce; and existing GenAI models struggle to generate dynamic urban functional monthly energy. We present DySENSE, a joint multimodal GenAI framework that synthesizes static urban satellite imagery together with spatially aligned, dynamic monthly building energy consumption maps. We decouple long-term static urban morphology from short-term dynamic energy consumption. By conditioning on static urban land use, DySENSE can generate realistic, diverse and new static urban imagery with aligned energy maps. By conditioning on dynamic monthly and climate prompts, DySENSE can jointly generate dynamic, monthly energy consumption maps while keeping the urban morphology static. Experiments across four cities (New York, Washington, Norfolk, Busan) demonstrated that DySENSE can generate annotated high-fidelity synthetic energy data using less than 25% labelled data, boosting downstream prediction performance by 8% mIoU, and achieving strong energy dynamic consistency. Compared to existing methods, DySENSE significantly improved prediction performance (8.7% accuracy) and reduced prediction error (9%-18% CVRMSE, ASHRAE). DySENSE offers an effective foundation for energy-efficient cities, peak-load analysis, building performance simulation and dynamic demand response for city, energy, and building science. The data and code: https://huggingface.co/datasets/skl24/MUSE2 and https://github.com/kailaisun/DySENSE
items.abstract_zh: 城市消耗全球三分之二以上的能源，并贡献超过 70% 的二氧化碳排放，城市能源对实现 2050 净零目标及联合国可持续发展目标 7 与 11 至关重要。现有研究多受数据与方法缺口限制：多针对既有城市做预测而非生成未来城市；细粒度、空间对齐的逐月动态能耗数据稀缺；现有生成式 AI 模型难以生成动态的城市功能月度能耗。本文提出 DySENSE，一个联合多模态生成式 AI 框架，可同时合成静态城市卫星影像与空间对齐的动态逐月建筑能耗图。该方法将长期静态城市形态与短期动态能耗解耦：以静态土地利用为条件，可生成真实、多样且能耗图对齐的新静态城市影像；以逐月与气候提示为条件，可在保持城市形态不变的前提下联合生成动态月度能耗图。在纽约、华盛顿、诺福克、釜山四座城市的实验表明，DySENSE 仅用不足 25% 标注数据即可生成带标注的高保真合成能耗数据，使下游预测提升 8% mIoU，并具有强能耗动态一致性；相较现有方法，预测性能提升 8.7% 准确率，预测误差降低 9%–18%（CVRMSE，ASHRAE）。该工作为节能城市、峰值负荷分析、建筑性能仿真与动态需求响应提供了有效基础。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Calpha: Toward Native Biomolecular Intelligence in a General-Purpose Language Model
items.title_zh: Calpha：迈向通用语言模型中的原生生物分子智能
items.abstract_en: Biomolecular foundation models predict the structures of proteins and their complexes accurately, and large language models (LLMs) reason in natural language, but the two remain separate: the abilities of the former are not part of a general-purpose LLM, and the reasoning of the latter does not enter a structure prediction. Calpha aims at one general model that folds proteins and complexes, understands protein sequence and structure, and lets its language reasoning influence the structures it predicts. This report covers the first step, in which an LLM outputs single-chain protein structures. Qwen3.5-9B reads a sequence enriched with ESM2 residue features. It can respond in text or emit a token that invokes a pretrained SimpleFold structure head, which receives information about the protein only through Qwen's residue states. Under a fixed folding request, the head achieves mean TM-scores of 0.808 on the FoldBench-334 development set, 0.635 on CASP16 domains and 0.900 on a CAMEO-style PDB set. We compare these predictions with a baseline in which ESM2-3B encodes the sequence and a fine-tuned SimpleFold-3B head predicts the coordinates. The two systems also differ in trainable weights, training duration and crop length. For chains of 100--299 residues, all three paired confidence intervals include zero. At 300--600 residues, the mean differences are -0.044, -0.160 and -0.025, respectively. In a separate test, four English request types triggered folding on every evaluated example. Protein training reduced accuracy on a 350-item MMLU-Pro subset from 77.4% to 70.3%. An LLM can therefore output single-chain structures from its own states, with lower long-chain scores in the current comparisons and reduced accuracy on the evaluated MMLU-Pro subset. Complex prediction, structure understanding and the effect of language reasoning on the predicted coordinates remain future work.
items.abstract_zh: 生物分子基础模型能准确预测蛋白质及其复合物结构，大语言模型（LLM）能进行自然语言推理，但两者彼此割裂：前者的能力不属于通用 LLM，后者的推理也不进入结构预测。Calpha 旨在构建单一通用模型，既能折叠蛋白质与复合物、理解蛋白序列与结构，又能让其语言推理影响所预测的结构。本报告介绍第一步：由 LLM 输出单链蛋白质结构。Qwen3.5-9B 读取融合 ESM2 残基特征的序列，可以用文本回应，也可以发出一个 token 调用预训练的 SimpleFold 结构头，而该结构头仅通过 Qwen 的残基状态获取蛋白质信息。在固定折叠请求下，该结构头在 FoldBench-334 开发集上平均 TM-score 为 0.808，CASP16 结构域为 0.635，CAMEO 风格 PDB 集为 0.900。作者将其与由 ESM2-3B 编码序列、微调 SimpleFold-3B 头预测坐标的基线比较，两系统在可训练权重、训练时长与裁剪长度上亦不相同。100–299 残基链上三个配对置信区间均包含零；300–600 残基上平均差异分别为 -0.044、-0.160 与 -0.025。另一项测试中，四类英文请求在全部评估样例上都成功触发折叠。蛋白训练使 350 题 MMLU-Pro 子集准确率从 77.4% 降至 70.3%。这表明 LLM 可基于自身状态输出单链结构，但当前比较中长链得分较低，且所评估的 MMLU-Pro 子集准确率有所下降。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对模型规模、上下文与任务难度；基准成绩不等同开放场景可靠性，代码和权重许可需分别检查。

items.title_en: Laser Processing for Energy Applications
items.title_zh: 面向能源应用的激光加工
items.abstract_en: Laser processing has emerged as a transformative technology in the energy sector, enabling precise, efficient, and scalable solutions for energy generation, storage, and sustainability. This chapter explores the diverse applications of laser technology in energy applications. It begins with an overview of laser-driven inertial confinement fusion for energy production, highlighting key experimental facilities and crucial laser parameters. The role of lasers in solar energy harvesting is examined, including photovoltaic cell optimization, concentrated solar power, and laser-assisted recycling of solar modules. The chapter further reviews recent developments into laser-based techniques for enhancing electrochemical performance through surface texturing at various scales. Advancements in lithium-ion battery technology are also discussed, focusing on next-generation materials, battery manufacturing processes, and the impact of laser techniques on performance, safety, and scalability. The chapter concludes with insights into future prospects for laser applications in sustainable energy solutions.
items.abstract_zh: 激光加工已成为能源领域的变革性技术，可为能源生产、储能与可持续性提供精确、高效且可规模化的解决方案。本章梳理激光技术在能源中的多种应用：首先概述用于能源生产的激光驱动惯性约束聚变，介绍关键实验装置与核心激光参数；随后考察激光在太阳能采集中的作用，包括光伏电池优化、聚光太阳能以及太阳能组件的激光辅助回收；并综述通过多尺度表面织构化提升电化学性能的激光技术新进展；还讨论锂离子电池技术进展，聚焦下一代材料、电池制造工艺，以及激光技术对性能、安全性和可扩展性的影响；最后展望激光在可持续能源方案中的未来前景。
items.highlight_zh: 系统梳理激光加工在聚变、光伏、电池等能源环节的应用与前景
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：能源领域（发电、储能、循环利用）需要精确、高效、可放大的加工手段，激光是否以及如何胜任？

内容与方法：这是一篇综述性质的章节，按应用场景分块梳理：
- 激光驱动惯性约束聚变：把激光当作点火能量源，介绍代表性实验装置与关键激光参数（能量、脉宽、聚焦条件等）。
- 太阳能：用激光工艺优化光伏电池、支撑聚光太阳能，并用激光辅助拆解、回收退役光伏组件。
- 电化学器件：通过不同尺度的表面织构化（微纳结构）增大有效面积、改善浸润与界面性质，从而提升电化学性能。
- 锂离子电池：面向下一代材料与制造流程，讨论激光在极片加工、结构调控等环节如何影响性能、安全与量产可扩展性。

结果与结论：文章不报告单一实验数据，而是归纳出激光在多个能源环节已具备实用价值，并对未来方向给出判断。

为何重要：对非本领域读者，这篇章节像一张“激光＋能源”的地图——它说明激光不只是实验室里的精密工具，还可能同时影响发电（聚变、光伏）、储能（电池）和循环利用（组件回收）三条主线。理解这些交叉点，有助于判断哪些能源技术路线可能因加工工艺突破而加速落地。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对数据划分、基线、消融与计算预算；结果的适用范围以原文实验为准。

items.title_en: VASR: Vector-Aware Assembly Planning with Equivalent Structures and Repair-Cost Feedback
items.title_zh: VASR：融合等价结构与修复代价反馈的向量感知装配规划
items.abstract_en: Furniture assembly planning requires inferring subassembly hierarchies from individual parts and a target illustration. Existing raster-based methods do not explicitly exploit the geometric and structural information in SVG drawings. We introduce VASR, a framework that fuses features from a dedicated SVG encoder with visual representations from a pretrained vision-language model to predict assembly hierarchies. To avoid penalizing valid alternatives to a reference assembly tree, we propose Repair-Aware Hierarchical Policy Optimization (RHPO) with hierarchy-preserving equivalence rewards. RHPO further uses repair-cost feedback to favor decisions with lower downstream correction costs among candidates with comparable equivalence-aware rewards. VASR achieves the highest Equivalent-Hard F1 among the evaluated methods, outperforming GPT6-Astra by 17.69 percentage points on the IKEA-derived test set while maintaining strong performance on an independent furniture dataset.
items.abstract_zh: 家具装配规划需要从单个零件与目标示意图推断子装配层级。现有基于栅格的方法未显式利用 SVG 图纸中的几何与结构信息。我们提出 VASR 框架，将专用 SVG 编码器提取的特征与预训练视觉-语言模型的视觉表示融合，用于预测装配层级。为避免惩罚参考装配树之外的有效替代方案，我们提出修复感知的层级策略优化（RHPO）与保持层级的等价性奖励；RHPO 进一步利用修复代价反馈，在等价性奖励相近的候选中优先选择下游纠错代价更低的决策。VASR 在评测方法中取得最高的 Equivalent-Hard F1，在 IKEA 衍生测试集上比 GPT6-Astra 高出 17.69 个百分点，并在独立家具数据集上保持强劲表现。
items.highlight_zh: 融合 SVG 编码与视觉模型做装配规划，并用修复代价反馈优化决策
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：给定一堆零件和一张家具示意图，装配系统要自动决定“先装哪部分、再装哪部分”，也就是推断子装配的层级结构。难点在于：同一件家具往往存在多种同样合理的装配顺序，若只拿一棵参考答案树去评判，就会误判本来正确的方案。

方法：
- VASR 用专门的 SVG 编码器提取图纸中的几何与结构信息（现有基于栅格图像的方法会丢掉这些信息），再与预训练视觉-语言模型的视觉特征融合，共同预测装配层级。
- 提出 Repair-Aware Hierarchical Policy Optimization（RHPO），配合“保持层级的等价性奖励”，让结构上与参考树等价的其他方案不被惩罚。
- RHPO 还引入修复代价反馈：在等价性奖励相近的候选里，优先挑选下游纠错代价更低的方案。

结果：在 IKEA 衍生测试集上，VASR 的 Equivalent-Hard F1 为对比方法中最高，比 GPT6-Astra 高出 17.69 个百分点；在独立的家具数据集上也保持较强表现。

为何重要：它把“等价答案”这一现实问题显式建模，使评测与优化不再死盯一棵参考树；同时用纠错代价引导决策，让规划结果更“好修”，对实际装配机器人更有价值。对非本领域读者，这相当于教机器看图装配时既懂图纸结构，也懂“条条大路通罗马”。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对训练数据、评测设置、显存和模型许可；示例与作者指标不能证明通用可靠性。

items.title_en: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
items.abstract_en: We introduce a new language representation model called BERT, which stands for Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers. Unlike recent language representation models, BERT is designed to pre-train deep bidirectional representations from unlabeled text by jointly conditioning on both left and right context in all layers. As a result, the pre-trained BERT model can be fine-tuned with just one additional output layer to create state-of-the-art models for a wide range of tasks, such as question answering and language inference, without substantial task-specific architecture modifications. BERT is conceptually simple and empirically powerful. It obtains new state-of-the-art results on eleven natural language processing tasks, including pushing the GLUE score to 80.5% (7.7% point absolute improvement), MultiNLI accuracy to 86.7% (4.6% absolute improvement), SQuAD v1.1 question answering Test F1 to 93.2 (1.5 point absolute improvement) and SQuAD v2.0 Test F1 to 83.1 (5.1 point absolute improvement).

reference_review.reason_zh: 双向语言表示预训练的原始研究与作者代码，适合编码器、微调和语言理解方法的比较。
reference_review.limitations_zh: 原版模型和 TensorFlow 实现较旧；编码器不是聊天生成模型，语言覆盖、输入长度与参数许可需核对。

recommendation.reason_zh: 双向语言表示预训练的原始研究与作者代码，适合编码器、微调和语言理解方法的比较。 截至 2026-11-13，Crossref 索引记录 11821 次引用，可作长期文献线索。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 原版模型和 TensorFlow 实现较旧；编码器不是聊天生成模型，语言覆盖、输入长度与参数许可需核对。

items.title_zh: BERT：面向语言理解的深度双向 Transformer 预训练
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种新的语言表示模型 BERT，即来自 Transformer 的双向编码器表示。与近期语言表示模型不同，BERT 旨在通过在所有层中同时联合左右两侧上下文，从无标注文本中预训练深度双向表示。因此，预训练好的 BERT 只需增加一个输出层即可微调，无需大量任务特定的结构改动，便能在问答、语言推断等广泛任务上取得当前最优结果。BERT 在概念上简单，在实证上强大：它在十一个自然语言处理任务上刷新最优成绩，包括把 GLUE 分数提升至 80.5%（绝对提升 7.7 个百分点）、MultiNLI 准确率提升至 86.7%（绝对提升 4.6 个百分点）、SQuAD v1.1 问答测试 F1 提升至 93.2（绝对提升 1.5 点）、SQuAD v2.0 测试 F1 提升至 83.1（绝对提升 5.1 点）。
items.highlight_zh: 双向预训练 + 单层微调，刷新 11 项 NLP 任务纪录
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：在 BERT 之前，语言表示模型多是单向的——读句子时只能从左往右看，或者把左右两个方向的模型简单拼接。这让模型难以同时利用上下文的两侧信息，而很多语言理解任务恰恰需要「前后兼顾」。

方法：BERT 用 Transformer 的编码器结构，在所有层中同时关注左右两侧上下文，做真正的深度双向预训练。预训练用两个任务：一是「掩码语言模型」，随机遮住句中的一些词让模型猜；二是「下一句预测」，判断两句话是否原本相邻。预训练完成后，只需在顶部加一个小的输出层，在具体任务上微调即可，不必为每个任务重新设计网络结构。

结果：在十一个自然语言处理任务上刷新当时最优成绩。GLUE 基准提升到 80.5%（绝对提升 7.7 个百分点），MultiNLI 准确率 86.7%（提升 4.6 点），SQuAD v1.1 问答测试 F1 达到 93.2（提升 1.5 点），SQuAD v2.0 测试 F1 达到 83.1（提升 5.1 点）。

为何重要：这篇论文确立了「大规模无标注预训练 + 下游小改动微调」的范式，概念简单却效果显著，深刻影响了此后几乎所有自然语言处理系统的研发方式，是预训练语言模型时代的奠基工作之一。

items.title_en: ScaleVLA: Scaling Vision-Language-Action Models to 552 Billion Parameters
items.title_zh: ScaleVLA：将视觉-语言-动作模型扩展到 5520 亿参数
items.abstract_en: Frontier Vision-Language Models (VLMs) such as GPT-6 Astra have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in robot control, suggesting that broad pretraining provides knowledge valuable for physical action. Yet most Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies still rely on much smaller VLM backbones, leaving this potential largely untapped. We ask whether frontier-scale representations can provide a stronger foundation for robot learning. We introduce ScaleVLA, which connects a 552B DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash backbone to a trainable action DiT, and systematically compare VLMs from 2B to 552B under a shared training setup. We evaluate three fundamental capabilities of robot foundation models. In sample efficiency, just 10 demonstrations outperform a 2B backbone trained with 50 (87.8% vs. 85.6%). In generalization, LIBERO-PRO success reaches 45.1%, compared with at most 31.3% for smaller backbones. In precise manipulation, real-world charger insertion improves from 4/10 to 9/10 successes, with gains concentrated in contact-sensitive alignment. Despite its scale, ScaleVLA achieves 216 ms median latency per action chunk. Our findings suggest that frontier VLMs can serve not only as reasoning agents, but also as powerful representational foundations for efficient and generalizable robot policies.
items.abstract_zh: GPT-6 Astra 等前沿视觉-语言模型（VLM）在机器人控制上表现卓越，说明大规模预训练知识对物理动作同样有价值，但多数视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略仍依赖小得多的 VLM 主干。我们提出 ScaleVLA，将 552B 的 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 主干与可训练的动作 DiT 相连，并在统一设置下系统比较 2B 至 552B 的 VLM。结果显示：仅 10 条示范即超过用 50 条示范训练的 2B 主干（87.8% 对 85.6%）；LIBERO-PRO 成功率达 45.1%，小主干至多 31.3%；真机充电器插入由 4/10 提升至 9/10，增益集中于接触敏感的对准环节；每个动作块的中位延迟 216 ms。这表明前沿 VLM 既能作推理智能体，也可作为高效、可泛化机器人策略的表征基础。
items.highlight_zh: 552B 主干让 VLA 用更少示范获得更强泛化与操作精度
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：机器人策略通常由一个视觉-语言模型（VLM）充当“大脑”，但多数视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型只用了较小的 VLM 主干。既然 GPT-6 Astra 这类前沿大模型已表现出机器人控制能力，把主干放大到极致能否带来更好的机器人学习？

方法：作者构建 ScaleVLA，把 552B 参数的 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 主干接到一个可训练的动作 DiT（扩散 Transformer）上，形成 VLA 策略；并在完全相同的训练设置下，从 2B 到 552B 系统对比不同规模的主干。

评估分三个维度：样本效率（需要多少示范）、泛化（LIBERO-PRO 基准）、精细操作（真机充电器插入）。

结果：
- 样本效率：仅用 10 条示范，成功率达 87.8%，超过用 50 条示范训练的 2B 主干（85.6%）。
- 泛化：LIBERO-PRO 成功率 45.1%，较小主干最高仅 31.3%。
- 精细操作：真机充电器插入从 4/10 提升到 9/10，提升主要集中在需要接触感知的对准环节。
- 效率：尽管模型巨大，每个动作块的中位延迟仅 216 ms。

为何重要：结果提示“规模”在机器人领域同样有效——前沿 VLM 不只是会推理的智能体，还能充当机器人策略的表征基础，用更少示范换取更好的泛化与更精准的操作。对普通读者而言，这意味着未来的机器人可能靠“更大的预训练大脑”，而不是堆积更多示教数据来学会干活。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需区分仿真与实机结果，核对传感器、执行器、控制频率及部署算力；未作本站复现。

items.title_en: Unbundling Multimodal Vision Encoding
items.title_zh: 拆解多模态视觉编码：视觉先验、专用容量与融合位置
items.abstract_en: How multimodal language models should encode visual input remains up for debate. Most models use a pretrained vision encoder, while some recent recipes train the encoder from scratch with the language model or remove it entirely. Vision encoders bundle together three design choices: a visual prior from upstream pretraining, dedicated vision capacity, and pre-fusion placement of that capacity (i.e., before the multimodal backbone). Because published models also differ in data, architecture, and compute, comparing them cannot isolate the effect of each choice. We disentangle these choices via a controlled framework where we pretrain all models from scratch on common data and compare them on visual question answering and language benchmarks at matched lifetime compute. We find that the visual prior is not necessary; an encoder trained jointly from scratch is on par with a pretrained one, without a separate training stage. What matters instead is dedicated vision capacity: an encoder-free model trails on visual understanding even when its backbone is enlarged by the encoder's parameter count. Yet that capacity need not precede multimodal fusion, as vision-only modules added in-fusion to early backbone layers perform comparably to a pre-fusion encoder and can lower time to first token. These results also hold across backbone sizes, when encoder pretraining is treated as free, and when starting from a pretrained language model. Overall, our findings favor dedicated vision capacity trained jointly with the backbone and placed early within it.
items.abstract_zh: 多模态语言模型如何编码视觉输入仍无定论：多数用预训练视觉编码器，也有方案与语言模型联合从零训练甚至完全去掉编码器。编码器实际捆绑了三种设计选择：上游预训练带来的视觉先验、专用视觉容量、以及把该容量置于多模态主干之前。由于公开模型在数据、架构与算力上各异，直接比较无法分离各因素。我们将所有模型在相同数据上从零预训练，并在等量生命周期算力下比较视觉问答与语言基准。结果显示视觉先验并非必需，联合从零训练的编码器与预训练编码器表现相当；真正关键的是专用视觉容量——无编码器模型即便扩大主干仍落后。但该容量不必位于融合前：在融合中向早期层加入纯视觉模块效果相当，还能降低首字延迟。这些结论支持与主干联合训练、置于主干早期的专用视觉容量。
items.highlight_zh: 视觉先验非必需，专用视觉容量才是关键
items.digest_zh:
【要解决的问题】能看图说话的多模态大模型，通常先用一个专门的视觉编码器把图片变成向量，再交给语言模型。这个编码器到底必要吗？它其实捆绑了三样东西：(1) 上游预训练带来的“视觉先验”；(2) 专门留给视觉的参数量；(3) 把视觉放在多模态融合之前的位置。以往公开模型在数据、结构、算力上都不一样，因此无法判断到底是哪一项在起作用。

【方法】作者把所有模型都放到同一份数据上从零开始训练，并让它们在整个训练生命周期内消耗相同的总算力，然后比较它们在视觉问答和纯语言任务上的表现，把三个因素逐一拆开来检验。

【结果】1) 视觉先验不是必需的：与语言模型一起从零训练的编码器，和预训练编码器打平，还省掉一个独立的训练阶段；2) 真正重要的是“专用视觉容量”——必须给视觉留出参数，把主干按编码器的参数量加大也补不回来；3) 容量不必放在融合之前：在融合过程中往主干靠前的层里插入视觉模块，效果差不多，还能更快吐出第一个 token。

【为何重要】这给多模态模型设计提供了清晰指引：不必执着于预训练视觉编码器，而应保留独立的视觉容量、与主干联合训练并放在早期层，同时也为降低推理延迟提供了可行方案。结论在多种主干规模下、以及把编码器预训练视作“免费”或从预训练语言模型出发时都成立。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对训练数据、评测设置、显存和模型许可；示例与作者指标不能证明通用可靠性。

items.title_en: Learning gene co-regulation across cells with Multicellular Transformer
items.title_zh: 用多细胞 Transformer 学习跨细胞基因共调控
items.abstract_en: Understanding how genes coordinate across cells is central to explaining tissue function and disease, yet most existing models still take a single cell as input and therefore emphasize cell-intrinsic regulation. We present the Multicellular Transformer (MCT), a foundation model built around a different assumption: cells function together within tissues, so the appropriate unit of input is not one cell in isolation but a set of cells from the same sample. By jointly modeling multiple cells, MCT learns context-aware gene embeddings that capture gene-gene interactions across the tissue environment. Trained on a large set of tissue samples (>4200) across more than 30 tissue types, MCT recovers ligand-receptor interactions, infers cross-cell signaling programs, and reveals spatial co-localization patterns directly from scRNA-seq data. Its contextual embeddings identify disease-specific rewiring of gene neighborhoods in systemic lupus erythematosus and COVID-19 and predict population-level perturbation effects in cancer without additional training. By linking gene-level regulation to tissue-scale organization, MCT provides a scalable framework for modeling multicellular biology and enables in silico discovery of therapeutic targets and tissue-specific dependencies.
items.abstract_zh: 理解基因如何在细胞间协同，是解释组织功能与疾病的核心，但多数现有模型仍以单个细胞为输入，因而侧重细胞内在调控。我们提出 Multicellular Transformer（MCT），其基本假设不同：细胞在组织内协同工作，合适的输入单元不是孤立的一个细胞，而是同一样本中的一组细胞。通过联合建模多个细胞，MCT 学到能捕捉组织环境中基因—基因互作的上下文感知基因嵌入。MCT 在 30 多种组织类型、逾 4200 个组织样本上训练，可直接从 scRNA-seq 数据中恢复配体—受体互作、推断跨细胞信号程序并揭示空间共定位模式。其上下文嵌入识别出系统性红斑狼疮与 COVID-19 中疾病特异的基因邻域重塑，并无需额外训练即可预测癌症中的群体水平扰动效应。MCT 将基因层面调控与组织尺度组织联系起来，为多细胞生物学建模提供可扩展框架，并支持治疗靶点与组织特异依赖性的计算发现。
items.highlight_zh: 以一组细胞为输入的基础模型，捕捉跨细胞基因调控
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：组织里的细胞不是各自为政，基因调控会跨细胞协同（例如一个细胞分泌配体、另一个细胞接收信号）。但现有大多数计算模型以单个细胞为输入，天然偏向“细胞内部”的调控，难以刻画这种跨细胞协作。

方法：作者提出 Multicellular Transformer（MCT），核心假设是：合适的输入单位不是孤立的一个细胞，而是同一样本中的一组细胞。模型联合建模多个细胞，学习“上下文感知”的基因嵌入，使同一基因在不同组织环境中获得不同表示。训练数据为 30 多种组织类型、4200 多个组织样本的单细胞 RNA 测序（scRNA-seq）数据。

结果：
- 能直接从 scRNA-seq 中恢复配体—受体互作、推断跨细胞信号程序、揭示空间共定位模式。
- 上下文嵌入可识别疾病特异的“基因邻域重塑”，在系统性红斑狼疮与 COVID-19 中发现异常。
- 无需额外训练即可预测癌症中群体水平的扰动效应。

为何重要：MCT 把“基因层面的调控”与“组织尺度的空间组织”连成一体，为多细胞生物学提供了一个可扩展的基础模型框架，并有望在计算机上（in silico）筛选治疗靶点、发现组织特异的基因依赖。对非本领域读者，它相当于给单细胞数据加上了“邻里关系”的视角，从看单个细胞转向看细胞群落如何对话。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对模型规模、上下文与任务难度；基准成绩不等同开放场景可靠性，代码和权重许可需分别检查。

items.title_en: Scaling laws in machine learning on non-ideal experimental data enable inverse design of radiative-cooling coatings
items.title_zh: 非理想实验数据下机器学习的标度律：实现辐射制冷涂层的逆向设计
items.abstract_en: Materials informatics increasingly targets multicomponent materials, yet experimental datasets inevitably contain non-ideal variations arising from imperfect uniformity and reproducibility in composition, coating formation, and measurement. Whether machine-learning prediction accuracy scales with amount of data under these conditions remains unclear. Here, we develop an automated platform that produced and optically characterized 11,520 radiative-cooling coatings spanning nine material and processing parameters. Forward and inverse neural networks, and a spectrum-conditioned diffusion model were trained on subsets of 10 to 10,000 samples. All models exhibited power-law scaling, with prediction errors decreasing with dataset size. Experimental inverse-design validation showed that larger datasets produced spectra closer to a broadband-emitter target. The diffusion model generated multiple candidate parameter sets, allowing selection among alternative solutions based on ease of fabrication, cost, and scalability. These results demonstrate predictable learning-curve scaling in non-ideal experimental data and provide a quantitative basis for estimating the benefit of additional experimental data, and thus the cost-effectiveness of materials-informatics.
items.abstract_zh: 材料信息学日益面向多组分材料，但实验数据不可避免地含有由成分、成膜与测量中均匀性和重复性不完美造成的非理想变异，此时预测精度能否随数据量提升仍不清楚。本文用自动化平台制备并光学表征了覆盖九个材料与工艺参数的11,520种辐射制冷涂层，并在10至10,000个样本的子集上训练前向与逆向神经网络以及一个以光谱为条件的扩散模型。所有模型均呈幂律标度，误差随数据量增大而下降；实验逆向设计验证显示，数据越多，实测光谱越接近宽带发射体目标。扩散模型可生成多个候选配方，便于按制备难度、成本与可放大性取舍。结果表明，非理想实验数据中的学习曲线可预测，为估算追加实验数据的收益与成本效益提供了定量依据。
items.highlight_zh: 非理想实验数据的学习曲线呈幂律标度，可量化评估数据成本效益
items.digest_zh:
• 研究问题：材料信息学用于多组分材料设计时，真实实验数据总带有成分不均、涂布不一致、测量误差等“不完美”因素。在这种数据上，模型精度是否随数据量按可预测的规律提升，此前并不清楚。
• 方法：搭建自动化平台，制备并光学表征11,520种辐射制冷涂层，覆盖9个材料与工艺参数。训练前向神经网络、逆向神经网络，以及一个以目标光谱为条件的扩散模型；训练集规模从10个样本逐步增至10,000个。
• 结果：三类模型都表现出幂律“学习曲线”，误差随数据量稳定下降。逆向设计的实验验证中，数据越多，实测光谱越接近宽带发射体目标。扩散模型能一次给出多组候选参数，便于按工艺难度、成本和可放大性挑选方案。
• 为何重要：说明即便实验数据带有噪声和非理想性，性能提升仍可被定量预测。这样就能在投入更多实验前估算“再测多少数据才划算”，为材料信息学的成本效益决策提供依据。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Reasoning in the loop: antibody lead optimization by probing mechanism and measurement
items.title_zh: 在环推理：通过探究机制与测量实现抗体先导优化
items.abstract_en: Lab-in-the-loop systems, in which a model proposes molecules, automated assays measure their properties and the results retrain the model, are a popular approach to antibody lead optimization. These systems optimize for a specification defined with metrics computed from instrument signals, so their success depends on how well those metrics serve as proxies for the properties a drug candidate needs. When a metric is a poor proxy, neither a better model nor more data will fix it, and identifying the problem usually requires expert review. We report two campaigns run on BigHat Biosciences' Milliner platform, one on an anti-albumin nanobody (VHH) and one on an anti-mesothelin single-chain variable fragment (scFv), in which a research team and a general-purpose AI agent, Claude, brought scientific reasoning into the loop. Over seven rounds and about 1,010 design variants we built libraries from antibody lineage, structure and biophysics, and found from the raw curves that on each scaffold one thermal metric did not measure what its name implied. The libraries were built as controlled comparisons, so the results also show what each mutation contributes to each property. We fit a physical model of the curves, used it to choose metrics suited to each scaffold, and changed the experimental protocol, varying protein concentration and heating rate, to test the model against pre-registered predictions. Both leads improve on their parents in affinity, thermal stability and aggregation while improving or maintaining yield and purity.
items.abstract_zh: lab-in-the-loop系统（模型提出分子、自动化实验测定性质、结果回馈重新训练模型）是抗体先导优化的常用方法。该系统针对由仪器信号算出的指标所定义的规格进行优化，因此成败取决于这些指标能否很好地代理候选药物真正需要的性质。若指标代理性差，更好的模型或更多数据都无法弥补，而识别问题通常依赖专家审查。我们报告在BigHat Biosciences的Milliner平台上开展的两项活动，分别针对抗白蛋白纳米抗体（VHH）和抗间皮素单链可变片段（scFv）；研究团队与通用AI智能体Claude将科学推理带入循环。经过七轮、约1,010个设计变体，我们依据抗体谱系、结构和生物物理构建文库，并从原始曲线发现每种支架上有一项热学指标并不测量其名称所暗示的性质。由于文库以受控比较方式构建，结果也揭示了每个突变对各性质的贡献。我们拟合曲线的物理模型，据此为每种支架选择合适指标，并修改实验方案（改变蛋白浓度与升温速率），用预注册预测检验模型。两个先导分子在亲和力、热稳定性和聚集方面均优于亲本，同时保持或提升产量与纯度。
items.highlight_zh: 把科学推理引入lab-in-the-loop，纠正指标错配，获得更优抗体先导
items.digest_zh:
• 问题：lab-in-the-loop抗体优化中，模型优化的目标是仪器信号算出的指标，而这些指标只是药物所需性质的“代理”。若代理本身选错了，换更好的模型或加更多数据都无济于事，而发现问题往往只能靠专家人工审查。
• 方法：在BigHat的Milliner平台上开展两轮实验，分别针对抗白蛋白纳米抗体VHH和抗间皮素scFv。研究团队与通用AI智能体Claude共同参与推理。七轮共约1,010个设计变体，文库依据抗体谱系、结构和生物物理设计，并刻意做成受控比较。
• 结果：从原始熔解曲线看出，每种支架上都有一项“热稳定性”指标名不副实。受控比较还量化了每个突变对各性质的贡献。团队拟合曲线的物理模型，为每种支架重选指标，并改动实验条件（蛋白浓度、升温速率），用预注册预测检验模型。最终两个先导在亲和力、热稳定性和聚集上都优于亲本，产量与纯度不降反升。
• 为何重要：说明“人在回路”的科学推理（辅以AI智能体）能纠正测量指标层面的根本错误，这是单纯加大数据或换模型无法解决的。

items.title_en: Syllable- and Word-Level Evaluation of Tibetan OCR
items.title_zh: 藏文OCR的音节级与词级评估
items.abstract_en: Optical character recognition (OCR) for Tibetan is evaluated predominantly by character error rate (CER). Tibetan marks syllable boundaries but does not mark word boundaries, so a word error rate requires a segmenter. This study evaluates nine recognizer configurations on typeset, woodblock and two handwritten script styles, alone and in combination, and reports syllable- and word-level error rates, to our knowledge the first for Tibetan OCR. The configurations span CTC models, TrOCR encoder-decoders with and without post-training quantization, and a vision-language model, and each is scored under CER, the syllable error rate (SER) and three segmented word error rates (SWER). CER ranks systems largely as the higher-level rates do (Kendall $τ\geq 0.833$), with one pair ordered oppositely. On the effect of joint training, CER and SER record significant changes of opposite sign in 7 of 64 comparisons. SER needs no segmenter and ranks systems as SWER does under two of the three segmenters ($τ\geq 0.889$). The output of each configuration is also tagged for part of speech, annotated for named entities and machine translated, and each result is compared with that obtained on the reference text. As rough guidance, translation chrF of 60 is reached at SER of 0.047 or below and part-of-speech preservation of 0.8 at 0.078 or below, while no error rate separates the systems that reach entity preservation of 0.6 from those that do not.
items.abstract_zh: 藏文OCR的评估主要采用字符错误率（CER）。藏文标记音节边界但不标记词边界，因此计算词错误率需要分词器。本研究在排版、木刻和两种手写书体（单独及组合）上评测九种识别器配置，报告音节级与词级错误率，据我们所知这是藏文OCR的首次。配置包括CTC模型、带与不带训练后量化的TrOCR编码器-解码器，以及一个视觉-语言模型；每种配置均在CER、音节错误率（SER）和三种分词词错误率（SWER）下评分。CER对系统的排序大体与更高层级错误率一致（Kendall τ≥0.833），仅一对系统顺序相反。关于联合训练的影响，64个比较中有7个CER与SER记录到符号相反的显著变化。SER无需分词器，在三种分词器中的两种下排序与SWER一致（τ≥0.889）。各配置输出还被词性标注、命名实体标注和机器翻译，并与参考文本上的结果比较。粗略参考：SER≤0.047时翻译chrF可达60，SER≤0.078时词性保持率约0.8；而无任何错误率能把达到0.6实体保持率的系统与未达到者区分开。
items.highlight_zh: 首次给出藏文OCR音节级与词级错误率，SER可免分词替代SWER排序
items.digest_zh:
• 问题：藏文OCR通常只用字符错误率（CER）评价，但藏文只标音节边界、不标词边界，要算词错误率必须先分词。字符级分数能否代表词级乃至下游任务表现，缺乏证据。
• 方法：在排版、木刻和两种手写体（单独及两两组合）上评测九种识别器配置：CTC模型、带/不带训练后量化的TrOCR编码器-解码器、以及一个视觉-语言模型。每者都计算CER、音节错误率SER，以及用三种分词器得到的词错误率SWER；输出还做词性标注、命名实体识别与机器翻译，并与参考文本结果对比。
• 结果：CER的系统排序大体与SER、SWER一致（Kendall τ≥0.833），仅一对系统顺序相反；联合训练带来的变化中，64个比较有7个CER与SER显著反向。SER无需分词器，在三种分词器中的两种下与SWER排序一致（τ≥0.889）。下游方面，SER≤0.047时翻译chrF可达60，SER≤0.078时词性保持率约0.8；但实体保持率是否达0.6，任何错误率都无法区分。
• 为何重要：为藏文OCR建立了首个音节级/词级评测基准，并指出SER可作为免分词的实用替代指标，同时警示字符级指标与下游表现并不总是一致。

items.title_en: FAST-LIO2: Fast Direct LiDAR-inertial Odometry
items.abstract_en: This paper presents FAST-LIO2: a fast, robust, and versatile LiDAR-inertial odometry framework. Building on a highly efficient tightly-coupled iterated Kalman filter, FAST-LIO2 has two key novelties that allow fast, robust, and accurate LiDAR navigation (and mapping). The first one is directly registering raw points to the map (and subsequently update the map, i.e., mapping) without extracting features. This enables the exploitation of subtle features in the environment and hence increases the accuracy. The elimination of a hand-engineered feature extraction module also makes it naturally adaptable to emerging LiDARs of different scanning patterns; The second main novelty is maintaining a map by an incremental k-d tree data structure, ikd-Tree, that enables incremental updates (i.e., point insertion, delete) and dynamic re-balancing. Compared with existing dynamic data structures (octree, R*-tree, nanoflann k-d tree), ikd-Tree achieves superior overall performance while naturally supports downsampling on the tree. We conduct an exhaustive benchmark comparison in 19 sequences from a variety of open LiDAR datasets. FAST-LIO2 achieves consistently higher accuracy at a much lower computation load than other state-of-the-art LiDAR-inertial navigation systems. Various real-world experiments on solid-state LiDARs with small FoV are also conducted. Overall, FAST-LIO2 is computationally-efficient (e.g., up to 100 Hz odometry and mapping in large outdoor environments), robust (e.g., reliable pose estimation in cluttered indoor environments with rotation up to 1000 deg/s), versatile (i.e., applicable to both multi-line spinning and solid-state LiDARs, UAV and handheld platforms, and Intel and ARM-based processors), while still achieving higher accuracy than existing methods. Our implementation of the system FAST-LIO2, and the data structure ikd-Tree are both open-sourced on Github.

items.title_zh: FAST-LIO2：快速直接的 LiDAR-惯性里程计
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出 FAST-LIO2：一个快速、鲁棒且通用的 LiDAR-惯性里程计框架。它建立在高效的紧耦合迭代卡尔曼滤波之上，并有两项关键创新，使其能实现快速、鲁棒且精确的 LiDAR 导航（与建图）。第一项是直接将原始点云配准到地图（并随后更新地图，即建图），无需提取特征。这既可利用环境中的细微特征从而提高精度，也因去除了人工设计的特征提取模块而天然适配不同扫描模式的新型 LiDAR。第二项创新是用增量式 k-d 树数据结构 ikd-Tree 维护地图，支持增量更新（点插入、删除）与动态再平衡。与现有动态数据结构（八叉树、R*-树、nanoflann k-d 树）相比，ikd-Tree 综合性能更优，且天然支持在树上做降采样。我们在来自多个公开 LiDAR 数据集的 19 个序列上做了详尽基准比较，FAST-LIO2 以远低的计算量稳定取得更高精度。我们还对小视场固态 LiDAR 开展了多项真实场景实验。总体而言，FAST-LIO2 计算高效（例如在大型室外环境中可达 100 Hz 的里程计与建图）、鲁棒（例如在杂乱室内环境中旋转高达 1000 度/秒时仍能可靠估计位姿）、通用（适用于多线旋转式与固态 LiDAR、无人机与手持平台、Intel 与 ARM 处理器），同时精度仍高于现有方法。
items.highlight_zh: 免特征提取直接配准，配合增量 k-d 树实现 100 Hz 建图
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：机器人或无人机要知道自己在哪、周围长什么样，常靠 LiDAR 加惯性测量单元（IMU）做里程计与建图。传统流程要从点云里先提取边缘、平面等「特征」再匹配，这一步既耗时，又会丢掉环境中的细微信息；而且换一种扫描方式的 LiDAR，特征提取就得重新设计。地图的数据结构在大场景下也容易成为瓶颈。

方法：FAST-LIO2 用紧耦合的迭代卡尔曼滤波把 LiDAR 与 IMU 数据融合。两个关键改动：一是跳过特征提取，把原始点云直接配准到地图并同步更新地图，既保留细微特征提升精度，也让它适配各种扫描模式的雷达；二是用自研的增量式 k-d 树 ikd-Tree 管理地图，支持点的插入、删除与动态再平衡，并能直接在树上降采样。

结果：在多个公开 LiDAR 数据集的 19 个序列上做基准比较，精度稳定高于现有先进系统，计算量却低得多。真实实验中，大型室外场景可达 100 Hz 的里程计与建图；在杂乱室内以高达 1000 度/秒的角速度旋转时仍能可靠估计位姿；可运行于多线旋转式与固态 LiDAR、无人机与手持平台、Intel 与 ARM 处理器。

为何重要：它把「快、稳、通用、准」四件事同时做到了，且不依赖特定雷达的特征设计，因而对不同硬件和新一代固态 LiDAR 都有很好的适应性，成为该领域被广泛采用的开源基准方案。

items.title_en: WeVisForensics: Self-Evolving Agent for Omni AI-Generated Video Detection
items.title_zh: WeVisForensics：用于全模态AI生成视频检测的自演化智能体
items.abstract_en: Recent advances in video generation call for reliable detection grounded in explicit forensic evidence. However, current methods primarily depend on single-pass chain-of-thought reasoning that overlooks brief or localized artifacts, or on predefined multi-agent workflows that offer limited flexibility in selecting relevant inspections. Even with adaptive investigation, optimizing the investigation policy alone does not directly improve the forensic capabilities of fixed experts. We introduce WeVisForensics, an agentic framework in which a main investigator agent coordinates a self-evolving library of forensic inspector sub-agents spanning visual and audio cues. The investigator learns which artifact type to examine, over which window, and when to conclude, and these interactions provide shared feedback for both levels of agents. Our dual-timescale policy optimization strategy, DTPO, closes this loop through fast reinforcement learning of the investigator and slower refinement of the inspectors, guided by annotated artifact intervals, to report subtle artifacts they once dismissed. Furthermore, we curate ForenCue-30K, combining role-specific forensic annotations and interaction trajectories to supervise individual inspections and their coordination, with an accompanying reinforcement-learning pool. Experiments show that WeVisForensics averages 95.2% detection accuracy across in-domain, out-of-domain and agentic benchmarks, 9.0% above the strongest prior detector, while grounding its verdicts in localized evidence.
items.abstract_zh: 视频生成的最新进展要求基于明确取证证据的可靠检测。然而，当前方法主要依赖单遍思维链推理，会忽略短暂或局部伪影；或依赖预定义多智能体工作流，在选择相关检查时灵活性有限。即使采用自适应调查，仅优化调查策略并不能直接提升固定专家的取证能力。我们提出WeVisForensics，一个智能体框架，其中主调查智能体协调一个跨越视觉和音频线索、可自演化的取证检查器子智能体库。调查智能体学习检查哪种伪影类型、在哪个窗口上检查以及何时结束；这些交互为两个层级的智能体提供共享反馈。我们的双时间尺度策略优化策略DTPO，通过在标注伪影区间引导下对调查智能体进行快速强化学习、对检查器进行较慢细化，闭合这一循环，以报告它们曾忽略的细微伪影。此外，我们构建ForenCue-30K，结合角色特定的取证标注和交互轨迹，以监督个体检查及其协调，并配有强化学习池。实验表明，WeVisForensics在域内、域外和智能体基准上平均达到95.2%的检测准确率，比最强先前检测器高9.0%，同时将其判定建立在局部证据上。

items.title_en: Language-guided domain adaptation improves protein sequence representations for antimicrobial resistance analysis
items.title_zh: 语言引导的域适应改善用于抗菌药物耐药性分析的蛋白质序列表示
items.abstract_en: Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in bacterial pathogens complicates infectious disease management. Protein sequences encode molecular features underlying resistance functions such as antibiotic inactivation and drug efflux, providing a basis for investigating bacterial AMR. Protein language models can extract transferable representations from these sequences. However, general purpose protein language models have limited capacity to represent AMR-associated sequences, while task-specific tools often address individual prediction problems. These limitations highlight the need for protein representations that better capture resistance associated functions and can be reused across complementary tasks, supporting systematic AMR analysis from sequence variation to functional relationships among proteins. We developed BacLLM, a language-guided protein representation framework that integrates annotation derived functional knowledge into protein language model representations for AMR analysis in bacterial pathogens. Through sequence enhancement, semantic enrichment of UniProt annotations, and cross modal contrastive learning, BacLLM transfers LLM encoded annotation priors into the sequence encoder, enabling sequence only inference after training. Compared with baseline models, BacLLM provided more informative representations of resistance associated sequences, achieving a mean F1 score of 0.956 across six AMR benchmarks with logistic regression, 2.7 percentage points above the strongest baseline. It also captured resistance associated mutational signals at single residue resolution and preserved taxonomic relationships not reflected by phenotype based clinical groupings. Moreover, BacLLM recovered resistance associated functional organization within a TolC centered protein association network, prioritizing proteins with low sequence identity to TolC but predicted structural similarity to TolC. Extending the same representation framework to an intervention oriented application, BacLLM also improved strain level phage host matching for phage therapy candidate prioritization. Together, these findings establish BacLLM as a reusable protein representation framework for analyzing resistance associated sequence variation and functional organization, with applications in AMR surveillance and phage candidate prioritization.
items.abstract_zh: 细菌病原体中的抗菌药物耐药性（AMR）使传染病管理复杂化。蛋白质序列编码耐药功能（如抗生素失活和外排药物）背后的分子特征，为研究细菌AMR提供基础。蛋白质语言模型可从这些序列中提取可迁移表示。然而，通用蛋白质语言模型表示AMR相关序列的能力有限，而任务特定工具通常只解决单个预测问题。这些局限凸显出需要更好地捕获耐药相关功能、并可跨互补任务复用的蛋白质表示，以支持从序列变异到蛋白质间功能关系的系统性AMR分析。我们开发了BacLLM，一个语言引导的蛋白质表示框架，将注释衍生的功能知识整合到蛋白质语言模型表示中，用于细菌病原体的AMR分析。通过序列增强、UniProt注释的语义丰富和跨模态对比学习，BacLLM将LLM编码的注释先验迁移到序列编码器中，使训练后仅需序列即可推理。与基线模型相比，BacLLM为耐药相关序列提供了信息更丰富的表示，在逻辑回归下于六个AMR基准上平均F1分数达到0.956，比最强基线高2.7个百分点。它还在单残基分辨率上捕获耐药相关突变信号，并保留了基于表型的临床分组未反映的分类学关系。此外，BacLLM在以TolC为中心的蛋白质关联网络中恢复了耐药相关功能组织，优先排序与TolC序列同一性低但预测与TolC结构相似的蛋白质。将同一表示框架扩展到面向干预的应用，BacLLM还改善了用于噬菌体治疗候选优先级排序的菌株水平噬菌体宿主匹配。总之，这些发现确立BacLLM作为一个可复用的蛋白质表示框架，用于分析耐药相关序列变异和功能组织，并应用于AMR监测和噬菌体候选优先级排序。

items.title_en: Symmerty-Engineered Moire Metasurface for Multibeam Control
items.title_zh: 对称性工程化莫尔超表面实现多波束调控
items.abstract_en: Moiré metasurfaces offer a versatile platform for wavefront engineering through the relative rotation of periodic structures. Despite extensive demonstrations of continuous beam steering, the physical mechanisms governing beam multiplicity remain poorly understood, hindering the systematic design of multibeam radiation states. Here, we establish a predictive framework for engineering beam multiplicity in reflective moiré metasurfaces based on the dominant Fourier coefficients of their constituent patterns. We reveal that the rotational symmetry of these Fourier components in reciprocal space fully determines the symmetry of the resulting moiré unit cell and, consequently, its radiation characteristics. By further incorporating their phase information, both beam multiplicity and steering trajectories can be accurately predicted. We demonstrate this approach using reflective moiré metasurfaces constructed from patterns with p6m, p3m1, and p4m plane-group symmetries, achieving one-, two-, three-, four-, and six-beam radiation states with continuously tunable steering trajectories. Beyond symmetry-based design, we identify two additional degrees of freedom for beam multiplicity control. Selecting different rotation centers reshapes the phase distributions of the dominant Fourier coefficients, enabling further manipulation of beam multiplicity and spatial arrangement, while varying the relative twist angle alters the pairing of Fourier components, inducing transitions between distinct beam multiplicities. These findings establish a systematic framework for versatile and reconfigurable multibeam wavefront engineering.
items.abstract_zh: 莫尔超表面通过周期结构的相对旋转为波前工程提供了灵活平台。尽管连续波束偏转已被大量演示，但决定波束数目的物理机制仍不清楚，阻碍了多波束辐射态的系统化设计。本文基于构成图案的主导傅里叶系数，建立了反射式莫尔超表面波束数目的可预测设计框架。我们揭示：这些傅里叶分量在倒空间中的旋转对称性完全决定了莫尔单胞的对称性，进而决定其辐射特性；进一步引入相位信息后，波束数目与偏转轨迹均可被准确预测。我们以具有 p6m、p3m1 和 p4m 平面群对称性的图案构建反射式莫尔超表面进行验证，实现了一、二、三、四、六波束辐射态，且偏转轨迹连续可调。除对称性设计外，我们还发现两个额外自由度：选择不同旋转中心可重塑主导傅里叶系数的相位分布，从而进一步操控波束数目与空间排布；改变相对扭转角则会改变傅里叶分量的配对关系，诱导不同波束数目之间的转换。这些结果建立了通用、可重构多波束波前工程的系统框架。
items.highlight_zh: 用傅里叶分量对称性预测莫尔超表面的波束数目与轨迹
items.digest_zh:
研究问题：莫尔超表面由两层周期图案相对旋转叠加而成，能连续偏转波束，但「为什么会出现多个波束、出现几个」缺乏理论解释，设计多波束器件只能靠试错。

方法：作者把每个构成图案分解为傅里叶级数，只看其中最强的几个「主导傅里叶分量」。他们发现，这些分量在倒空间（描述空间频率的数学空间）里的旋转对称性，直接决定了叠加后莫尔单胞的对称性，也就决定了最终能辐射出几束光；再把分量的相位信息纳入，还能算出每束光的偏转轨迹。作者用具有 p6m、p3m1、p4m 三种平面群对称性的图案制作反射式超表面做验证。

结果：成功得到一、二、三、四、六波束的辐射态，偏转轨迹可连续调节。此外还找到两个额外调控旋钮：换一个旋转中心会改变主导傅里叶分量的相位分布，从而改变波束数目与空间排布；改变两层之间的扭转角会改变傅里叶分量的配对方式，使波束数目发生跳变。

为何重要：这把原本靠经验的莫尔超表面多波束设计，变成了可以「先算后做」的预测性设计流程，对需要多目标、可重构波束的通信、雷达与成像应用有直接价值。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需区分仿真与实机结果，核对传感器、执行器、控制频率及部署算力；未作本站复现。

items.title_en: The Transformer Paradigm: Dynamic Processing and a New Principle of Inference
items.title_zh: Transformer 范式：动态处理与一种新的推理原理
items.abstract_en: We argue that the Transformer revolution is not adequately understood as a merely quantitative expansion of deep learning, but as the emergence of a new paradigm based on a different principle of inference. We interpret the Transformer as a system in which token representations are transformed by parameterized transformations, or transforming concepts. During inference, some of these transformations are dynamically constructed from the current input: previously acquired transformations are first adapted and then applied. At the mechanical-structural level, this dynamic processing is realized through output-weight interconnections, whereby outputs of some networks determine the weights of others. The resulting mode of processing, which we call Sequence-level Interactive Dynamic Parallel Processing (SIDPP), provides a framework for explaining strong prompt sensitivity and opens research directions concerning interpretability, control, alternative AI architectures, neuromorphic systems, and possible biological realizations of dynamic processing.
items.abstract_zh: 我们认为，把 Transformer 革命仅仅理解为深度学习的量级扩张并不充分，它其实代表了一种基于不同推理原理的新范式。我们把 Transformer 视为这样一个系统：词元表示被参数化的变换（即“变换概念”）所改造。在推理过程中，其中一些变换是根据当前输入动态构建的：先对先前习得的变换加以适配，再予以应用。在机械-结构层面，这种动态处理通过输出-权重互连实现，即某些网络的输出决定了另一些网络的权重。由此得到的处理方式我们称为序列级交互式动态并行处理（SIDPP），它为解释强烈的提示敏感性提供了框架，并开辟了可解释性、控制、替代 AI 架构、神经形态系统以及动态处理可能的生物学实现等研究方向。
items.highlight_zh: Transformer 是动态构造变换的新推理范式（SIDPP）
items.digest_zh:
【核心主张】人们常把 Transformer 的成功归结为“模型更大、数据更多”的量变。作者认为这不够准确：Transformer 代表的是一种新的推理原理。

【怎么理解】可以把 Transformer 想成一套“变换概念”——每个词元（token）的表示都会被一系列带参数的变换改造。关键在于：推理时，其中一部分变换是固定不变的，另一部分则根据当前输入现场构建出来——先把已学到的变换加以适配，再施加到表示上。这种“边读边造工具”的机制，是它与传统前馈网络最根本的区别。

【结构上如何实现】作者指出，这种动态性通过“输出-权重互连”实现：某些网络的输出直接决定另一些网络的权重，于是处理流程会随输入而变。作者把这种模式称为序列级交互式动态并行处理（SIDPP）。

【解释力】它给一个长期困扰使用者的现象提供了框架性解释：为什么提示词改动几个字，模型输出会大不相同——因为输入本身参与了计算规则的构造。

【为何重要】这一视角把 Transformer 从“更大的神经网络”重新定位为一种新的推理范式，并由此提出若干研究方向：可解释性（如何读懂动态构造的变换）、控制（如何干预这些变换）、设计替代架构、神经形态硬件，以及这种动态处理在生物神经系统中可能的实现形式。

items.title_en: PaperCritic: Training AI Reviewers to Assess the Soundness of Papers
items.title_zh: PaperCritic：训练AI审稿人以评估论文的健全性
items.abstract_en: As AI conference submissions grow rapidly, AI reviewers are being considered as an alternative. However, simply imitating human reviewing is problematic because reviewing serves multiple purposes, including evaluating papers' soundness, interestingness, and clarity, the last two of which are subjective. In this work, we focus solely on evaluating soundness, the most important and objective criterion, and define the learning objective as jointly maximizing (1) precision, based on the soundness and substantiveness of review points, and (2) recall, the coverage of high-quality reference review points. Under this problem formulation, we construct a quality-labeled review point dataset, PaperSound-23K, using 1K ICLR submissions and 23K human-written and LLM-generated review points. Using this dataset, we train an AI reviewer model, PaperCritic, through reinforcement learning with the F1 score of precision and recall as the reward. Our experiments show that PaperCritic outperforms frontier models and models trained with other AI reviewer training methods on an in-domain test set. Surprisingly, learning to review ICLR submissions also transfers to reviewing Nature-family papers and even to out-of-domain reviewing tasks (e.g., code review, legal contract review, and feedback on story writing).
items.abstract_zh: 随着AI会议投稿快速增长，AI审稿人正被考虑作为替代方案。然而，简单模仿人类审稿是有问题的，因为审稿服务于多重目的，包括评估论文的健全性、有趣性和清晰度，其中后两者是主观的。在本工作中，我们仅关注评估健全性这一最重要且客观的标准，并将学习目标定义为联合最大化：(1) 精确率，基于评审点的健全性和实质性；(2) 召回率，即对高质量参考评审点的覆盖。在此问题表述下，我们使用1K篇ICLR投稿和23K个人工撰写与LLM生成的评审点，构建了带质量标签的评审点数据集PaperSound-23K。使用该数据集，我们通过以精确率和召回率的F1分数为奖励的强化学习，训练了AI审稿人模型PaperCritic。实验表明，在域内测试集上，PaperCritic优于前沿模型和其他AI审稿人训练方法训练的模型。令人惊讶的是，学习审阅ICLR投稿还可迁移到审阅Nature系列论文，甚至迁移到域外审稿任务（例如代码审查、法律合同审查和故事写作反馈）。

items.title_en: Polygraph: Large-Scale Multi-Session Trajectory Optimization using Pose Graphs
items.title_zh: Polygraph：使用位姿图的大规模多会话轨迹优化
items.abstract_en: Robots, vehicles, and wearable devices often traverse the same environment many times. Each pass produces its own trajectory from onboard visual or visual-inertial odometry. These trajectories are locally accurate but drift over time and live in unrelated coordinate frames. Turning many such independent trajectories into one globally consistent set is the large-scale multi-session trajectory optimization problem. Existing solutions largely work offline. All sessions must be available up front, one session is fixed as the reference frame, and a single fused map is then optimized. This paper presents Polygraph, a multi-session trajectory optimization pipeline that processes sessions online, one keyframe and one spatial cluster at a time, and never builds a 3D map. Keyframes are grouped into local clusters. When a cluster closes, it is matched against every other session through learned image retrieval. Candidate pairs are verified with sparse feature matching, monocular metric depth, and robust pose estimation. A two-tier consensus gate admits a cross-session edge into the shared pose graph only once independent evidence corroborates it. A cheap incremental solve keeps the graph current, and a periodic robust batch solve prunes outliers. We evaluate Polygraph on stereo outdoor driving, HoloLens and iPad indoor traversals, legged indoor locomotion with a Boston Dynamics Spot, and large-scale outdoor vehicle and handheld routes. Against the closest prior work on the same GPU model, using its reported timings, Polygraph runs faster, commits fewer loop-closure edges, and matches or improves on accuracy.
items.abstract_zh: 机器人、车辆和可穿戴设备常多次经过同一环境。每次经过都会根据机载视觉或视觉惯性里程计生成自己的轨迹。这些轨迹局部准确，但会随时间漂移，并处于不相关的坐标系中。将许多此类独立轨迹转化为一个全局一致集合，就是大规模多会话轨迹优化问题。现有解决方案大多离线工作：所有会话必须预先可用，一个会话被固定为参考系，然后优化单个融合地图。本文提出Polygraph，一个多会话轨迹优化流水线，在线处理会话，一次一个关键帧和一个空间簇，且从不构建3D地图。关键帧被分组为局部簇。当簇闭合时，通过学习到的图像检索将其与每个其他会话匹配。候选对用稀疏特征匹配、单目度量深度和鲁棒位姿估计进行验证。两级共识门控仅在独立证据佐证后才允许跨会话边进入共享位姿图。低成本的增量求解保持图最新，周期性鲁棒批处理求解修剪离群值。我们在立体户外驾驶、HoloLens和iPad室内行进、使用Boston Dynamics Spot的腿式室内运动，以及大规模户外车辆和手持路线上评估Polygraph。与同一GPU型号上最接近的先前工作相比（使用其报告的计时），Polygraph运行更快、提交的闭环边更少，并在准确率上持平或更优。

items.title_en: FAVR: Flow-Aware Visual Residual Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Policies
items.title_zh: FAVR：面向视觉-语言-动作策略的流感知视觉残差对齐
items.abstract_en: Pretrained video representations provide rich temporal information for robotic manipulation, yet effectively integrating them into existing vision-language-action (VLA) policies remains challenging. We present Flow-Aware Visual Residual Alignment (FAVR), a lightweight framework for flow-aware visual conditioning of frozen VLA policies. FAVR maintains a compact temporal visual state through linear Test-Time Training (TTT) and retrieves action-conditioned visual features throughout flow-based action generation. By exploiting the affine structure of the frozen action head, we explicitly characterize how injected visual features influence predicted action velocities and formulate flow-aware channel selection as a box-constrained optimization problem. We develop a FISTA-based solver for joint gate optimization and derive an efficient closed-form approximation through diagonalization and rescaling. With only 1.74-2.19M trainable parameters and 5,000 adaptation steps, FAVR improves pretrained VLA policies across benchmarks. On RoboTwin 2.0, FAVR improves LingBot-VLA from 87.12% to 90.04% under clean conditions and from 86.88% to 89.38% under randomized conditions. A controlled ablation on five RoboTwin tasks further shows that flow-aware gating increases average success from 72.0% with a gate shared across flow steps to 82.0%, demonstrating the benefit of adapting visual conditioning throughout action generation.
items.abstract_zh: 预训练视频表示可为机器人操作提供丰富的时间信息，但将其有效集成到现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略中仍具挑战。我们提出流感知视觉残差对齐（FAVR），一个用于冻结VLA策略的流感知视觉条件化的轻量级框架。FAVR通过线性测试时训练（TTT）维护紧凑的时间视觉状态，并在基于流的动作生成过程中检索动作条件化的视觉特征。通过利用冻结动作头的仿射结构，我们明确刻画注入的视觉特征如何影响预测的动作速度，并将流感知通道选择形式化为箱约束优化问题。我们开发基于FISTA的求解器进行联合门控优化，并通过对角化和重缩放推导高效的闭式近似。FAVR仅有1.74–2.19M可训练参数和5,000个适应步骤，却在多个基准上改善了预训练VLA策略。在RoboTwin 2.0上，FAVR在干净条件下将LingBot-VLA从87.12%提升至90.04%，在随机化条件下从86.88%提升至89.38%。在五个RoboTwin任务上的受控消融进一步表明，流感知门控将平均成功率从跨流步骤共享门控的72.0%提高到82.0%，证明在整个动作生成过程中适应视觉条件化的益处。

items.title_en: Unlocking Programmable and Creative RNA Sequence Design with RDiffusion
items.title_zh: 以RDiffusion解锁可编程且创造性的RNA序列设计
items.abstract_en: RNA, a pillar of the central dogma, has shaped three billion years of evolution. Despite cataloging tens of millions of non-coding RNAs and annotating millions, we have barely scratched the surface of the vast, unexplored RNA sequence space. Here, we introduce RDiffusion, a discrete-diffusion-based generative transformer model for RNA sequence design. Conditioned on diverse biological features, such as desired function, family type, secondary and tertiary structure, or binding protein partners, it can guide the generation of novel RNA sequences tailored to specific design specifications. We evaluate RDiffusion across a broad spectrum of RNA design tasks and find that it not only surpasses all baseline methods in design success rate and sequence diversity but also achieves advanced performance on downstream tasks. To demonstrate its translational potential, we applied RDiffusion with a customized seed-screening pipeline to de novo design therapeutic MicroRNA(miRNA) mimics in osteoarthritis (OA). This strategy identified mimic 0-4 as a lead candidate targeting SDC4 to preserve ECM homeostasis and cartilage integrity, with robust efficacy validated in clinical OA samples. Altogether, RDiffusion holds strong potential to serve as a cornerstone for RNA generation and representation learning, establishing a generalizable AI-driven paradigm for RNA therapeutic discovery.
items.abstract_zh: RNA作为中心法则的支柱，塑造了三十亿年的进化。尽管已编目数千万条非编码RNA并注释数百万条，我们仍几乎未触及浩瀚且尚未探索的RNA序列空间。在此，我们介绍RDiffusion，一个基于离散扩散的生成式Transformer模型，用于RNA序列设计。以多种生物特征为条件，如所需功能、家族类型、二级和三级结构或结合蛋白伴侣，它可以指导生成针对特定设计规格定制的新颖RNA序列。我们在广泛的RNA设计任务上评估RDiffusion，发现它不仅在设计成功率和序列多样性上超过所有基线方法，而且在下游任务上取得先进性能。为展示其转化潜力，我们将RDiffusion与定制的种子筛选流水线应用于骨关节炎（OA）中的治疗性MicroRNA（miRNA）模拟物的从头设计。该策略确定mimic 0-4为靶向SDC4的先导候选，以维持ECM稳态和软骨完整性，并在临床OA样本中验证了稳健疗效。总之，RDiffusion有很强的潜力成为RNA生成和表示学习的基石，建立一种可推广的AI驱动RNA治疗发现范式。

items.title_en: Intrinsic Berry Curvature on the Higher-order Poincare Sphere
items.title_zh: 高阶庞加莱球上的内禀贝里曲率
items.abstract_en: Higer-order geometric phase enable versatile spin-orbit manipulation of structured light . Con ventional theories describe this phase via a total-angular-momentum dependent Berry curvature . We develop an intrinsic theory restricted to the effective two-dimensional subspace, where the Berry curvature is independent of the topological charge of the light field . In our framework, the total-angular-momentum difference does not alter the effective monopole strength, whereas it controls the solid angle enclosed by the trajectory of the state evolution, insteadly. Our theory provides a different topological interpretation of geometric phase of the structured light, which unifies the underlying structures of generalized Poincare Spheres. Furthermore, it does not impose any specific form on the physical operation of the optical element, naturally encomoassing the case of previously reported experiment, and can be applied in arbitrary state evolutions in both classical structured light and quantum spin-orbit systems .
items.abstract_zh: 高阶几何相位使结构光能够实现多功能的动量和自旋-轨道操控。传统理论通过依赖于总角动量的贝里曲率来描述该相位。我们提出一种限制在有效二维子空间中的内禀理论，其中贝里曲率与光场的拓扑电荷无关。在我们的框架中，总角动量差不会改变有效单极强度，而是控制状态演化轨迹所包围的立体角。我们的理论为结构光的几何相位提供了不同的拓扑解释，统一了广义庞加莱球的底层结构。此外，它不对光学元件的物理操作施加任何特定形式，自然涵盖先前报道实验的情形，并可应用于经典结构光和量子自旋-轨道系统中的任意状态演化。

items.title_en: Asymmetric Multimodal Learning with Decomposed JEPAs
items.title_zh: 基于分解式JEPA的非对称多模态学习
items.abstract_en: Cross-modal alignment is the standard objective for building multimodal representations. We show that alignment as a \emph{sole} objective is lossy wherever modalities are informationally asymmetric---where neither can express what the other carries. Visual question answering is an obvious case: a question is a selective relational operator probing a dense visual field whose fine-grained features no query recovers, so what alignment preserves is not what the task requires. We prove an \textbf{Alignment Redundancy Bound}: alignment-only Dirichlet energy minimization retains at most the redundant information atom $\Red(Z; X_1, X_2)$, annihilating private modality-specific structure $\Unq(Z; X_m)$ and cross-modal synergy $\Syn(Z; X_1, X_2)$. We introduce \textbf{Decomposed JEPA (D-JEPA)}, which factorizes latents into an aligned shared core and private modality-specific fibers. The shared core retains most of the structure alignment targets; the private fibers recover what alignment discards, via contextual masked prediction and asymmetric cross-subspace independence. Under information asymmetry, alignment-only training undergoes catastrophic semantic collapse on compositional reasoning benchmarks, surviving only on binary queries. D-JEPA averts this collapse, substantially improving downstream accuracy over both alignment-only and alignment-with-reconstruction baselines, and restoring a positive multimodal synergy gap in place of the baseline's inverted gap. Information-theoretic audits confirm that D-JEPA recovers most of the mutual information available from a frozen backbone, and causal fiber-swap interventions demonstrate that the recovered information is causally localized in the private fibers.
items.abstract_zh: 跨模态对齐是构建多模态表示的标准目标。我们表明，只要模态在信息上是不对称的——即任一模态都无法表达另一模态所携带的信息——将对齐作为唯一目标就是有损的。视觉问答是一个明显例子：问题是一个选择性关系算子，用于探测密集视觉场，而任何查询都无法恢复该视觉场的细粒度特征，因此对齐所保留的并非任务所需。我们证明了对齐冗余界：仅对齐的狄利克雷能量最小化至多保留冗余信息原子 Red(Z; X_1, X_2)，并湮灭私有模态特定结构 Unq(Z; X_m) 与跨模态协同 Syn(Z; X_1, X_2)。我们提出分解式JEPA（D-JEPA），将潜在变量分解为对齐的共享核心和私有的模态特定纤维。共享核心保留对齐所针对的大部分结构；私有纤维通过上下文掩码预测和非对称跨子空间独立性恢复对齐所丢弃的信息。在信息不对称下，仅对齐训练在组合推理基准上经历灾难性语义坍缩，仅在二元查询上幸存。D-JEPA避免了这种坍缩，在仅对齐基线和带重建的对齐基线之上显著提高下游准确率，并恢复了正的多模态协同差距，而非基线的倒置差距。信息论审计确认，D-JEPA恢复了冻结骨干网络所能提供的大部分互信息，因果纤维交换干预表明恢复的信息因果地定位于私有纤维中。

items.title_en: WebArena-Pro: A Heterogeneous, Multimodal, Reproducible Benchmark for Web Agents
items.title_zh: WebArena-Pro：面向 Web 智能体的异构、多模态、可复现基准
items.abstract_en: Web agents powered by large language and vision-language models are increasingly applied to realistic browser work that spans heterogeneous applications, multimodal content, and stateful workflows. However, existing reproducible web-agent benchmarks cover only a small number of web applications drawn from a few software categories, and restrict modality to text and vision. Live benchmarks broaden site coverage but sacrifice reproducibility, since pages and data drift between runs. Moreover, existing benchmarks do not meaningfully evaluate whether agents can understand and use audio and video content embedded within web tasks. To address these gaps, we introduce WebArena-Pro, a benchmark comprising 300 tasks across 20 self-hosted web applications in six domain categories, spanning distinct interface conventions, workflows, and data models. Across the evaluated agents, the best performance is achieved by both Codex with GPT 6.1 Sol and Claude Code with Claude Opus 5.5 at 62.3%, followed by OpenCode with Kimi 3.1 Pro at 60.7%. The strongest GenericAgent configurations, Gemini 3.1 Pro omni and Gemma4 31B, both achieve 30.3%. Among reproducible, human-curated web agent benchmarks, WebArena-Pro provides the broadest application coverage and the most comprehensive multimodal support to date. The benchmark treats audio and video as core observations alongside text and vision, with dedicated actions for extracting information from each. WebArena-Pro runs each task in isolation and supports reproducible, parallel evaluation. Tasks are authored through a dedicated annotator interface, filtered by LLM-assisted triage, and finally validated by humans before release. Project page: https://webarena-pro.github.io
items.abstract_zh: 由大语言模型与视觉-语言模型驱动的 Web 智能体，正越来越多地用于跨异构应用、含多模态内容且有状态流程的真实浏览器工作。然而现有可复现的 Web 智能体基准只覆盖少数软件类别中的少量 Web 应用，且模态仅限文本与视觉；实时（Live）基准虽扩大了站点覆盖，却因页面与数据在两次运行间漂移而牺牲了可复现性；此外，现有基准无法真正评估智能体能否理解并使用网页任务中嵌入的音频与视频内容。为此，我们提出 WebArena-Pro：包含 20 个自托管 Web 应用、6 个领域类别下的 300 个任务，覆盖不同的界面约定、工作流与数据模型。在受评智能体中，Codex 搭配 GPT 6.1 Sol 与 Claude Code 搭配 Claude Opus 5.5 同以 62.3% 取得最佳成绩，OpenCode 搭配 Kimi 3.1 Pro 以 60.7% 紧随其后；最强的 GenericAgent 配置（Gemini 3.1 Pro omni 与 Gemma4 31B）均为 30.3%。在可复现、人工整理的 Web 智能体基准中，WebArena-Pro 提供了迄今最广的应用覆盖与最全面的多模态支持：音频与视频与文本、视觉一样被视为核心观测，并为每类模态设计了专门的信息抽取动作。每个任务隔离运行，支持可复现的并行评测；任务经专门标注界面撰写、LLM 辅助筛选，并在发布前由人工校验。
items.highlight_zh: 20 个自托管应用、300 个任务，音频视频也成核心观测
items.digest_zh:
【研究什么问题】让 AI 智能体像人一样用浏览器完成真实工作（订票、填表、跨站点搬运信息）是热门方向，但评测标准跟不上：已有的可复现基准往往只测少数几个网站、几类软件，而且只看文字和图片；覆盖站点多的"实时基准"又不可复现，因为网页和数据每次运行都在变。更关键的是，网页里嵌的音频、视频内容几乎没被考察过。
【用了什么方法】作者构建 WebArena-Pro：20 个自托管 Web 应用、跨 6 个领域类别的 300 个任务，各应用的界面风格、操作流程与数据模型都不一样，尽量模拟真实的多应用环境。音频和视频被提升为"核心观测"，并为每种模态设计了专门的动作来抽取信息。每个任务在隔离环境中运行，可并行、可复现；任务由专门的标注界面撰写，经 LLM 辅助筛选，发布前由人工校验。
【有什么结果】最强成绩来自 Codex 配 GPT 6.1 Sol 与 Claude Code 配 Claude Opus 5.5，同为 62.3%；OpenCode 配 Kimi 3.1 Pro 为 60.7%；而最强的通用型智能体配置（Gemini 3.1 Pro omni、Gemma4 31B）只有 30.3%。也就是说，即便是最好的系统，仍有近四成任务失败，且专用智能体框架与"开箱即用"的通用配置之间存在约 30 个百分点的巨大鸿沟。
【为何重要】它在可复现、人工整理的 Web 智能体基准里实现了最广的应用覆盖与最全的多模态支持，把音频、视频纳入评测，填补了既有基准的两处空白，为衡量智能体能否胜任真实浏览器工作提供了统一标尺。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对训练数据、评测设置、显存和模型许可；示例与作者指标不能证明通用可靠性。

items.title_en: WinDEX: Metric 3D Hand Motion Reconstruction in the Wild for Dexterous Teleoperation and Policy Learning
items.title_zh: WinDEX：面向灵巧遥操作与策略学习的野外米制三维手部运动重建
items.abstract_en: Human manipulation data are widely used to train robots for human-like dexterity. However, low-cost, large-scale collection in the wild remains challenging. Existing methods remain limited in geometrically grounded metric-scale reconstruction, real-world generalization and inference speed. We present WinDEX, integrating (1) geometric-temporal optimization for metric 3D hand annotation from in-the-wild egocentric stereo videos, combined with visual-inertial SLAM for world-frame reconstruction; (2) WinDEX-Net, an end-to-end, fisheye-native network combining calibrated stereo, local detail and temporal context, with a data-model flywheel of model-assisted annotation and retraining; (3) distilled models for offline reconstruction and causal streaming, supporting reinforcement learning and teleoperation; and (4) low-cost CyberCap stereo-inertial capture, forming the WinDEX-Hand dataset with 1,000 hours of training annotations and held-out human-annotated in-the-wild 2D and independent optical motion-capture evaluation sets. Offline reconstruction runs at 43.61 FPS and causal streaming at 171 FPS. On held-out data, offline reconstruction achieves state-of-the-art accuracy: 14.5 pixels in-the-wild reprojection error and, with visual-inertial odometry, 37.29 mm world-frame joint error. We achieve 7.6 and 3.6 times the task success rates of reinforcement learning policies trained with WiLoR and HaWoR motion references, respectively, and demonstrate real-time arm-hand teleoperation. Project website: https://fruitrabbit.github.io/WinDEX/.
items.abstract_zh: 人体操作数据被广泛用于训练机器人实现类人灵巧性，但低成本、大规模的野外采集仍然困难。现有方法在具有几何依据的米制尺度重建、真实世界泛化和推理速度上仍有局限。我们提出WinDEX，集成四部分：(1) 几何-时序优化，从野外第一人称立体视频标注米制三维手，并结合视觉-惯性SLAM完成世界坐标系重建；(2) WinDEX-Net，一个端到端、原生支持鱼眼的网络，融合标定立体、局部细节与时序上下文，并配以模型辅助标注与再训练的数据-模型飞轮；(3) 用于离线重建与因果流式推理的蒸馏模型，支持强化学习与遥操作；(4) 低成本CyberCap立体-惯性采集设备，构建WinDEX-Hand数据集，含1,000小时训练标注以及留出的人工标注野外2D与独立光学动捕评估集。离线重建43.61 FPS，因果流式171 FPS。在留出数据上离线重建达到最先进精度：野外重投影误差14.5像素，结合视觉-惯性里程计的世界坐标系关节误差37.29 mm。相比以WiLoR和HaWoR运动参考训练的强化学习策略，任务成功率分别提高7.6倍和3.6倍，并演示了实时手臂-手部遥操作。
items.highlight_zh: 野外米制手部重建达SOTA，强化学习任务成功率提升7.6倍
items.digest_zh:
• 问题：训练机器人灵巧操作需要大量人手操作数据，但低成本、大规模、可在野外采集的方案仍很困难。现有方法难以同时做到有几何依据的米制尺度重建、真实场景泛化和实时推理速度。
• 方法：WinDEX由四部分组成：几何-时序优化从野外第一人称立体视频中标注米制三维手部，并用视觉-惯性SLAM恢复世界坐标系；WinDEX-Net是端到端、原生支持鱼眼相机的网络，融合标定立体、局部细节与时序上下文，并配有“模型辅助标注—再训练”的数据飞轮；蒸馏模型支持离线重建与因果流式推理，服务强化学习和遥操作；低成本CyberCap立体-惯性采集硬件，用于构建含1,000小时标注的WinDEX-Hand数据集及留出评估集。
• 结果：离线重建43.61 FPS、流式推理171 FPS；留出数据上野外重投影误差14.5像素，加入视觉-惯性里程计后世界坐标系关节误差37.29 mm，为当时最优。用其运动参考训练强化学习策略，任务成功率分别为WiLoR和HaWoR参考的7.6倍与3.6倍，并演示了实时手臂-手部遥操作。
• 为何重要：把“低成本野外采集—米制重建—策略学习—遥操作”打通为闭环，让大规模人手操作数据真正可用于机器人灵巧操作训练。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为三维与定位，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对传感器、标定、尺度与算力；重建画质和可用的定位精度属于不同指标。

items.title_en: VA-Assembly: View-Aligned Score Guidance for Training-Free 3D Part Assembly
items.title_zh: VA-Assembly：用于免训练3D部件装配的视角对齐分数引导
items.abstract_en: Image-to-3D foundation models have improved 3D reconstruction, but typically produce monolithic representations without explicit part-level structure. Part-aware generation and learning-based assembly methods often require part-level supervision, category-specific priors, or paired part-layout training data. We instead consider a practical but underexplored setting in which independently prepared or generated 3D parts have no predefined inter-part relationships, shared coordinate frames, or consistent scales, and must be assembled into a reference-consistent object from a single image. We present VA-Assembly, a training-free framework for 3D part assembly through part-level transformation estimation using view-aligned diffusion guidance. Given a reference image and fixed 3D part geometries, VA-Assembly optimizes each part's translation, rotation, and scale. We condition a frozen view-conditioned diffusion model on same-view renderings of a reference-derived monolithic 3D representation, producing score gradients geometrically aligned with the part configuration. This guidance provides multi-view structural cues under large initial misalignment. By repurposing pretrained visual-structural priors as transformation-level supervision, VA-Assembly requires no annotated part layouts, predefined part taxonomies, category-specific assembly training, or bounding-box-based layout initialization. Experiments compare VA-Assembly with geometric registration and compositional layout baselines using each baseline's supported transformation components, showing improved part-wise transformation estimation. Ablation studies show that view-aligned conditioning, rather than diffusion guidance alone, is critical for reliable transformation gradients. Updating only part transformations preserves explicit component separability and supports component-level editing, replacement, and reconfiguration.
items.abstract_zh: 图像到3D基础模型改进了3D重建，但通常产生没有显式部件级结构的整体表示。部件感知生成和基于学习的装配方法往往需要部件级监督、类别特定先验或成对部件-布局训练数据。我们转而考虑一种实际但尚未充分探索的设置：独立准备或生成的3D部件没有预定义的部件间关系、共享坐标系或一致尺度，并且必须从单张图像装配成与参考一致的对象。我们提出 VA-Assembly，一个通过视角对齐扩散引导进行部件级变换估计的免训练3D部件装配框架。给定参考图像和固定的3D部件几何，VA-Assembly 优化每个部件的平移、旋转和尺度。我们以由参考导出的整体3D表示的同视角渲染为条件，驱动一个冻结的视角条件扩散模型，产生与部件配置在几何上对齐的分数梯度。该引导在较大初始错位下提供多视角结构线索。通过将预训练视觉-结构先验重新用作变换级监督，VA-Assembly 不需要标注的部件布局、预定义部件分类体系、类别特定装配训练或基于边界框的布局初始化。实验使用每个基线支持的变换组件，将 VA-Assembly 与几何配准和组合布局基线进行比较，显示部件级变换估计得到改善。消融研究表明，视角对齐条件（而非仅扩散引导）对于可靠的变换梯度至关重要。仅更新部件变换可保持显式组件可分离性，并支持组件级编辑、替换和重配置。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为三维与定位，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
