items.title_en: Generation of protein conformations using a simple inverted transformer
items.title_zh: 使用简单倒置Transformer生成蛋白质构象
items.abstract_en: Molecular dynamics is an extremely powerful approach for studying protein behavior, but it requires enormous computational resources to obtain an adequate sampling of possible conformations. Recently, thanks to successes in predicting three-dimensional protein structures, there has been an explosion of research exploring the opportunities offered by deep learning to address the problem of protein conformational landscape. In this work, an artificial intelligence system based on a variant of the Transformer architecture is introduced and applied to the problem of determining the ensemble of three-dimensional structures that a protein can access and their statistical weight. After being trained on a dataset of conformations of a particular protein obtained using classical all-atom molecular dynamics, this neural network is able to directly generate physically plausible protein conformations similar to those obtained both through molecular dynamics and experimentally. The ordered sequence of conformations obtained as output of the neural network rapidly converges towards the most populated regions of the protein's conformational landscape, suggesting that the system may have learned not only the protein's three-dimensional organization but also the thermodynamic weights of the various feasible conformations. These features, combined with its simplicity and low computational load, make this Transformer variant an ideal candidate for the development of systems capable of performing generative molecular dynamics.
items.abstract_zh: 分子动力学是研究蛋白质行为的极强大方法，但需要巨大计算资源才能对可能构象进行充分采样。近年来，得益于三维蛋白质结构预测的成功，探索深度学习解决蛋白质构象景观问题的研究激增。本工作引入一种基于 Transformer 架构变体的人工智能系统，并将其应用于确定蛋白质可访问的三维结构集合及其统计权重的问题。在使用经典全原子分子动力学获得的特定蛋白质构象数据集训练后，该神经网络能够直接生成物理上合理的蛋白质构象，类似于通过分子动力学和实验获得的构象。神经网络输出的有序构象序列迅速收敛到蛋白质构象景观中布居最多的区域，表明该系统可能不仅学习了蛋白质的三维组织，还学习了各种可行构象的热力学权重。这些特征，结合其简单性和低计算负载，使这一 Transformer 变体成为开发能够执行生成式分子动力学系统的理想候选。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对模型规模、上下文与任务难度；基准成绩不等同开放场景可靠性，代码和权重许可需分别检查。

items.title_en: Breaking the Fixed-Substrate Limitation of Deep Learning Ellipsometry with Pseudo-Substrate Spectra
items.title_zh: 利用伪衬底光谱打破深度学习椭偏术的固定衬底限制
items.abstract_en: A machine learning method, deep learning ellipsometry (DLE), enables direct and rapid estimation of the optical constants and structures of thin films from spectroscopic ellipsometry (SE) spectra. However, conventional neural-network-based DLE models are restricted to the specific substrate used during training, and applying them to a different substrate requires ~100 h of retraining. Here, we propose a framework that overcomes this fixed-substrate limitation by introducing a two-input feature-wise linear modulation DLE (FiLM-DLE). In this model, the SE spectra of a thin-film structure are input together with those of the substrate measured before film deposition, which we term the pseudo-substrate spectra. Any substrate, including a multilayer stack, is thus represented solely by its measured SE response, analogous to the pseudo-dielectric function, so that no prior knowledge of the substrate structure is required. Trained on a virtual dataset of 165 million samples representing metal, glass, and SiO2/Si substrates with different SiO2 thicknesses, a single FiLM-DLE model, trained once, extracts thin-film optical constants and structures with high accuracy and shows strong applicability to substrates not included in the training datasets. Experimental validation on 47 thin-film samples across diverse substrates yielded sample-averaged mean absolute errors, relative to conventional manual analysis, of 0.047 for refractive index, 0.030 for extinction coefficient, and 1.52 nm for thickness, with each analysis completed in under 2 s. FiLM-DLE thus eliminates the need for a separate DLE model for each substrate and enables rapid, high-accuracy optical characterization of thin films on diverse substrates.
items.abstract_zh: 一种机器学习方法——深度学习椭偏术（DLE）——能够从光谱椭偏（SE）谱直接、快速地估计薄膜的光学常数和结构。然而，传统基于神经网络的 DLE 模型受限于训练时使用的特定衬底，将其应用于不同衬底需要约100小时的重新训练。在此，我们提出一种通过引入双输入特征级线性调制 DLE（FiLM-DLE）来克服固定衬底限制的框架。在该模型中，薄膜结构的 SE 谱与薄膜沉积前测量的衬底 SE 谱（我们称为伪衬底光谱）一起输入。因此，任何衬底（包括多层堆叠）仅由其测得的 SE 响应表示，类似于伪介电函数，从而不需要衬底的先验结构知识。在代表金属、玻璃和不同 SiO2 厚度 SiO2/Si 衬底的1.65亿样本虚拟数据集上训练后，单个仅训练一次的 FiLM-DLE 模型能够高精度提取薄膜光学常数和结构，并对未包含在训练数据集中的衬底表现出强适用性。在跨多种衬底的47个薄膜样品上进行实验验证，相对于传统人工分析，样品平均绝对误差为：折射率0.047、消光系数0.030、厚度1.52 nm，每次分析在2秒内完成。因此，FiLM-DLE 消除了为每个衬底单独建立 DLE 模型的需要，并能够对多种衬底上的薄膜进行快速、高精度光学表征。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对数据划分、基线、消融与计算预算；结果的适用范围以原文实验为准。

items.title_en: Federated TD Learning in Heterogeneous Environments with Average Rewards: A Two-timescale Approach with Polyak-Ruppert Averaging
items.title_zh: 平均奖励下异构环境中的联邦TD学习：一种带Polyak-Ruppert平均的双时间尺度方法
items.abstract_en: Federated Reinforcement Learning (FRL) provides a promising way to speedup training in reinforcement learning when one has access to multiple edge devices that can operate in parallel. Recently, it has been shown that even when these edge devices have access to different dynamic models---such as cars or robots with differing system configurations---an optimal convergence rate that has a linear speedup proportional to the number of devices is achievable. However, this result requires that the algorithm's stepsize be chosen in a manner that depends on the unknown model parameters. Also, it applies only to a discounted setting, which has been argued to fit episodic tasks better than continuing control tasks. In this paper, we obtain finite-time bounds for heterogeneous FRL with average rewards. We show that optimal convergence rate and linear speedup are achievable even with a universal stepsize choice, independent of the underlying dynamics. To achieve our result, we modify the existing one-timescale FRL method to a novel two-timescale variant that additionally incorporates iterate averaging. We remark that this idea also extends to other settings already studied in the literature, such as the homogeneous FRL or the heterogeneous case with a discounted cost function.
items.abstract_zh: 联邦强化学习（FRL）为在可访问多个可并行运行的边缘设备时加速强化学习训练提供了一种有前景的方式。最近研究表明，即使这些边缘设备访问不同的动态模型——例如具有不同系统配置的汽车或机器人——也能实现与设备数量成正比线性加速的最优收敛速率。然而，该结果要求算法步长以依赖未知模型参数的方式选择。并且，它仅适用于折扣设置，而有观点认为折扣设置比持续控制任务更适合分幕任务。在本文中，我们获得了平均奖励下异构FRL的有限时间界。我们表明，即使采用与底层动态无关的通用步长选择，也能实现最优收敛速率和线性加速。为实现该结果，我们将现有单时间尺度FRL方法修改为一种新颖的双时间尺度变体，并额外加入迭代平均。我们指出，这一思想也可扩展到文献中已研究的其他设置，例如同质FRL或带折扣代价函数的异构情形。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为机器人感知与控制，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需区分仿真与实机结果，核对传感器、执行器、控制频率及部署算力；未作本站复现。

items.title_en: Beyond Job Titles: Interpreting Early-Career Job Advertisements with Sparse Autoencoders and Semantic Clustering
items.title_zh: 超越职位名称：用稀疏自编码器和语义聚类解读早期职业招聘广告
items.abstract_en: Job titles and job descriptions alone provide limited insight into how technical roles differ in a changing job market. To assess how such roles differ in their work and industry applications, we design and compare two methods based on deep learning and transformer representations using 36,081 early-career job postings collected from LinkedIn in the United States between December 2025 and October 2026. We first apply PERC, short for Preprocessing (P), Embedding (E), Dimensionality Reduction (R) and Clustering (C). We employ GPT-6 Luna to classify job description passages into Team context, Role task and Qualifications. We then create combinations of these sections and examine whether embedding and clustering the segmented passages produce meaningful semantic clusters about different job roles. We use Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) to rank observed differences between embedding distributions and employ a pretrained sparse autoencoder (SAE) to extract features from layer-19 representations of Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. Lastly, we employ GPT-6 Luna to come up with hypotheses about job roles' feature patterns, and GPT-6.1 Terra to investigate whether those patterns exist in held-out job descriptions from unseen companies. Some example findings include Data Scientist advertisements placing more emphasis on machine learning model development, Data Analyst advertisements on reporting business performance, and Machine Learning Engineer advertisements on applying developed models in real-world settings. We also observe differences in the applications described by Data Analyst and Business Analyst advertisements across selected months, although our dataset's scale and uneven coverage limit their interpretation. Overall, we present a realistic application of SAEs and PERC to unstructured textual data and examine how automated insight extraction could support manual analysis of job descriptions.
items.abstract_zh: 仅凭职位名称和职位描述，对技术岗位在变化中的就业市场中如何不同所提供的洞察有限。为评估此类岗位在工作内容和行业应用上的差异，我们使用2025年12月至2026年10月期间从美国LinkedIn收集的36,081条早期职业招聘信息，设计并比较了两种基于深度学习和Transformer表示的方法。我们首先应用PERC，即预处理（P）、嵌入（E）、降维（R）和聚类（C）的缩写。我们采用GPT-6 Luna将职位描述段落分类为团队背景、角色任务和任职资格。然后，我们创建这些部分的组合，并考察对分段段落进行嵌入和聚类是否会产生关于不同岗位角色的有意义的语义聚类。我们使用最大均值差异（MMD）对嵌入分布之间观察到的差异进行排序，并采用预训练的稀疏自编码器（SAE）从Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct第19层表示中提取特征。最后，我们采用GPT-6 Luna提出关于岗位角色特征模式的假设，并采用GPT-6.1 Terra研究这些模式是否存在于来自未见公司的留出职位描述中。一些示例发现包括：数据科学家招聘广告更强调机器学习模型开发，数据分析师招聘广告更强调报告业务绩效，机器学习工程师招聘广告更强调将已开发的模型应用于真实世界环境。我们还观察到数据分析师和业务分析师招聘广告在所选月份中描述的应用存在差异，尽管我们数据集的规模和覆盖不均限制了对其的解释。总体而言，我们展示了SAE和PERC对非结构化文本数据的现实应用，并考察自动洞察提取如何支持对职位描述的人工分析。

items.title_en: ROSE: A Shared Cross-Embodiment Facial-Motion Latent Space for Humanoid Robot Expression
items.title_zh: ROSE：用于人形机器人表情的共享跨具身面部运动潜在空间
items.abstract_en: Natural, coherent full-face dynamic expressions are central to making humanoid robots socially approachable, yet existing systems commonly realize only limited lip motion or scripted expressions. The limitation is both physical and algorithmic. A compact head leaves little room for densely packed, independently controllable actuation; meanwhile, learned systems often generate an avatar video, landmarks, or facial parameters and then infer actuator commands through visual retargeting. This render-and-invert path adds latency and artifacts, and it does not reliably transfer generated behavior to a physical robot. We present ROSE (RObot facial expression through Shared motion Embeddings), a framework that integrates biomimetic hardware, cross-embodiment motion representation learning, and multimodal motion generation. On the hardware side, we build a flexible tendon-sheath transmission structure that integrates 34 actuators into a 19.5 cm biomimetic head. By decoupling actuator placement from facial action points, it enables coordinated full-face expression within a compact volume. On the algorithmic side, ROSE-VAE learns an identity-independent shared facial-motion latent space from human, digital-human, and robot observations. ROSE-Flow directly maps text, audio, or their combination to trajectories in this motion space without using video as a generator input. ROSE-ACT then converts these trajectories into constrained actuator commands. Our system demonstrates how high-density biomimetic hardware and a shared executable facial-motion representation can jointly unify cross-embodiment learning, multimodal generation, and physical robot expression.
items.abstract_zh: 自然、连贯的全脸动态表情是使人形机器人在社交上易于接近的核心，但现有系统通常只能实现有限的唇部运动或脚本化表情。这一限制既是物理上的，也是算法上的。紧凑的头部几乎无法为密集排列且可独立控制的驱动装置留出空间；同时，学习型系统通常生成虚拟形象视频、关键点或面部参数，然后通过视觉重定向推断执行器命令。这种“渲染-反演”路径会增加延迟和伪影，并且不能可靠地将生成的行为迁移到物理机器人上。我们提出ROSE（通过共享运动嵌入实现机器人面部表情），这是一个整合仿生硬件、跨具身运动表示学习和多模态运动生成的框架。在硬件方面，我们构建了一种柔性腱鞘传动结构，将34个执行器集成到19.5 cm的仿生头部中。通过将执行器布置与面部动作点解耦，它能够在紧凑体积内实现协调的全脸表情。在算法方面，ROSE-VAE从人类、数字人和机器人观测中学习与身份无关的共享面部运动潜在空间。ROSE-Flow直接将文本、音频或二者组合映射到该运动空间中的轨迹，而不使用视频作为生成器输入。随后，ROSE-ACT将这些轨迹转换为受约束的执行器命令。我们的系统展示了高密度仿生硬件和共享的可执行面部运动表示如何共同统一跨具身学习、多模态生成和物理机器人表情。

items.title_en: VisDrone-ReID: A Unified Multi-Category Object Re-Identification Benchmark
items.title_zh: VisDrone-ReID：统一的多类别目标重识别基准
items.abstract_en: Object re-identification (Re-ID) benchmarks remain predominantly confined to single-category evaluations, limiting the development of unified systems capable of operating across diverse object types. This paper presents VisDrone-ReID, a unified multi-category Re-ID benchmark derived from the VisDrone2019-MOT dataset through a principled conversion pipeline. The pipeline resolves structural incompatibilities between multi-object tracking annotations and Re-ID evaluation requirements, addressing sequence-scoped identity collision, temporal redundancy, and the absence of a principled identity-level train/test split. The resulting benchmark comprises 9,516 identities and 150,016 images across ten object categories - pedestrian, people, bicycle, car, van, truck, tricycle, awning-tricycle, bus, and motor, sourced from 80 unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) sequences captured across urban environments. A leave-one-out (LOO) evaluation protocol is adopted to provide a comprehensive assessment. Baseline experiments across four representative Re-ID models spanning CNN and transformer architectures establish the first systematic performance reference on this benchmark. Results reveal a consistent Rank-1 to mAP gap across all models, suggesting that VisDrone-ReID presents a genuine retrieval challenge beyond nearest-neighbour matching. Per-category analysis identifies pedestrian as the most challenging category and reveals that vision-language pretraining provides a measurable advantage on semantically distinctive categories. VisDrone-ReID provides a consistent platform for studying multi-category object re-identification under the scale variation, viewpoint challenges, and category diversity characteristic of real-world surveillance scenarios.
items.abstract_zh: 目标重识别（Re-ID）基准仍主要局限于单类别评估，限制了能够跨多样目标类型运行的统一系统的发展。本文提出VisDrone-ReID，这是一个通过有原则的转换流程从VisDrone2019-MOT数据集衍生的统一多类别Re-ID基准。该流程解决了多目标跟踪标注与Re-ID评估要求之间的结构性不兼容问题，处理了序列范围内的身份冲突、时间冗余，以及缺乏有原则的身份级训练/测试划分的问题。所得基准包含来自城市环境中采集的80个无人机（UAV）序列的10个目标类别——行人、人群、自行车、汽车、厢式货车、卡车、三轮车、带篷三轮车、公交车和摩托车——的9,516个身份和150,016张图像。采用留一法（LOO）评估协议以提供全面评估。涵盖CNN和Transformer架构的四个代表性Re-ID模型的基线实验，建立了该基准上的首个系统性性能参考。结果揭示了所有模型中一致的Rank-1到mAP差距，表明VisDrone-ReID呈现出超越最近邻匹配的真实检索挑战。按类别分析将行人确定为最具挑战性的类别，并揭示视觉-语言预训练在语义上具有区分度的类别上提供了可测量的优势。VisDrone-ReID提供了一个一致的平台，用于研究真实世界监控场景所特有的尺度变化、视角挑战和类别多样性下的多类别目标重识别。

items.title_en: From the possible to the optimal: differentiable optimization of gene regulatory networks
items.title_zh: 从可能到最优：基因调控网络的可微优化
items.abstract_en: Understanding the space of ``the actual and the possible'' regulatory architectures capable of realizing biological functions is one of the major challenges in biology. Optimization-based approaches can rationalize regulatory mechanisms from functional objectives and constraints, but their computational cost has limited them to finding individual solutions. Here, we introduce \texttt{jaxgrn}, a framework that combines differentiable programming with stochastic simulations of gene regulatory networks (GRNs) to optimize thousands of networks end-to-end on GPUs. Using morphogen-driven embryonic patterning as a case study, we optimize networks for domain formation and positional information, while varying constraints on input noise, boundary precision and scaling with system size. While recovering known archetypes for scaling, we find that varying the constraints organizes optimal solutions into qualitatively distinct regimes. When optimizing domain formation, we observe phenotypic convergence across a continuum of regulatory architectures, ranging from input-driven to feedback-driven networks. When optimizing positional information, solutions are initially phenotypically diverse despite moderate variation in regulatory architecture; imposing scaling drives both phenotypic and regulatory convergence of the optimized networks onto a few recurring regulatory architectures. Our systematic approach opens the door for variational systems biology in which changing functional constraints reshape the landscape of possible phenotypes and regulatory architectures.
items.abstract_zh: 理解能够实现生物功能的“实际与可能”调控架构空间，是生物学的主要挑战之一。基于优化的方法可以从功能目标和约束出发合理化调控机制，但其计算成本使这些方法局限于寻找单个解。在此，我们介绍jaxgrn，一个将可微编程与基因调控网络（GRN）随机模拟相结合的框架，可在GPU上端到端优化数千个网络。以形态发生素驱动的胚胎模式化为案例研究，我们针对结构域形成和位置信息优化网络，同时改变对输入噪声、边界精度和随系统尺寸缩放（scaling）的约束。在恢复已知的缩放原型的同时，我们发现改变约束会将最优解组织成性质上不同的区域。在优化结构域形成时，我们观察到跨调控架构连续统的表型收敛，范围从输入驱动网络到反馈驱动网络。在优化位置信息时，尽管调控架构有适度变化，解最初在表型上是多样的；施加缩放约束会驱动优化网络在表型和调控上均收敛到少数反复出现的调控架构。我们的系统化方法为变分系统生物学打开了大门，其中改变功能约束会重塑可能表型和调控架构的景观。

items.title_en: Optimization Framework for Full-Skyrmionic Polarimetry
items.title_zh: 全斯格明子偏振测量的优化框架
items.abstract_en: Optical skyrmionic beams hold considerable potential for applications in quantum information and weak-intensity detection. These applications require accurate measurements of full topological observables using imaging Stokes polarimetry, with measurement states optimized in advance to limit the effect of stochastic error sources. However, the optimization framework for general Stokes polarimetries is based on a linear reconstruction chain for Stokes vectors and cannot quantitatively evaluate the nonlinear reconstruction of topological observables. Here, we define full-skyrmionic polarimetry (FSP) and construct its optimization framework from the reconstruction chain for full topological observables. Based on existing polarization evaluating functions (PEF), we introduce topological evaluating functions (TEF) and develop a multi-stage FSP optimization methodology. Numerical results confirm that topological optimization can further improve the reconstruction of topological observables, even when the measurement states are already optimal for polarization. Increasing the redundant projection number also effectively suppresses the effects of all stochastic error sources, providing a low-cost methodology to improve the reconstruction of both polarization and topological observables. The FSP optimization framework can identify topologically optimal configurations for arbitrary FSP structures, providing a guideline for high-precision full-skyrmionic measurements at weak-intensity levels and potential skyrmion ellipsometry.
items.abstract_zh: 光学斯格明子光束在量子信息和弱强度检测应用中具有相当大的潜力。这些应用需要利用成像斯托克斯偏振测量精确测量完整拓扑可观测量，并预先优化测量状态以限制随机误差源的影响。然而，通用斯托克斯偏振测量的优化框架基于斯托克斯矢量的线性重建链，无法定量评估拓扑可观测量的非线性重建。在此，我们定义全斯格明子偏振测量（FSP），并从完整拓扑可观测量的重建链构建其优化框架。基于现有的偏振评估函数（PEF），我们引入拓扑评估函数（TEF），并开发了一种多阶段FSP优化方法。数值结果证实，即使测量状态对偏振而言已经最优，拓扑优化仍可进一步改善拓扑可观测量的重建。增加冗余投影数量也有效抑制所有随机误差源的影响，提供了一种低成本方法来改善偏振和拓扑可观测量的重建。FSP优化框架可以为任意FSP结构识别拓扑最优配置，为弱强度水平下的高精度全斯格明子测量和潜在的斯格明子椭偏测量提供指导。

items.title_en: Learning What Pairs Miss for Higher-Order Multimodal Alignment
items.title_zh: 学习成对关系遗漏的内容以实现高阶多模态对齐
items.abstract_en: Contrastive learning beyond two modalities now scores the whole tuple with multilinear products, volumes, and fusion heads, critics that can represent the joint distribution. In practice these critics still behave like bags of pairs. Their negatives break at least two of the three pairs, a single pairwise check rejects them, and when most samples can be solved by pairs the higher-order term receives almost no gradient. To solve this problem, we propose CHORD (Contrastive Higher-Order Residuals with Decoys), which trains a residual against decoys drawn from a calibrated pairwise model, negatives that the pairwise model finds plausible, so that rejecting them often needs all three modalities. Drawing decoys costs one inner-product query over a memory bank, and the optimal residual is the log-ratio between the data and the pairwise model, so the decoy loss also bounds what that model misses. On M3-Mix, where one in ten training samples needs all three modalities, our CHORD improves accuracy on those samples by 21.2 percentage points over the strongest of eight baselines. CHORD also gives the best two-to-one results on every real dataset, and its residual improves other retrievers without retraining.
items.abstract_zh: 超越两种模态的对比学习现在使用多线性乘积、体积和融合头来对整个元组打分，这些评论器能够表示联合分布。在实践中，这些评论器仍表现得像成对关系的集合。它们的负样本至少破坏三个配对中的两个，单次成对检查即可拒绝它们；并且当大多数样本可由配对解决时，高阶项几乎接收不到梯度。为解决此问题，我们提出CHORD（带诱饵的对比高阶残差），其针对从校准的成对模型抽取的诱饵训练残差；这些诱饵是成对模型认为合理的负样本，因此拒绝它们通常需要全部三种模态。抽取诱饵的成本是对记忆库的一次内积查询，而最优残差是数据与成对模型之间的对数比，因此诱饵损失也界定了该模型所遗漏的内容。在M3-Mix上，每十个训练样本中有一个需要全部三种模态，我们的CHORD在这些样本上将准确率相比八个基线中最强基线提高了21.2个百分点。CHORD还在每个真实数据集上给出最佳的“二对一”结果，并且其残差无需重新训练即可改进其他检索器。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Rubric-Based AES with LLM Ensembles: Scoring of Student Responses in Critical Online Reasoning Using Ensembles of LLMs
items.title_zh: 基于评分量规的AES与LLM集成：使用LLM集成对批判性在线推理中的学生回答进行评分
items.abstract_en: Grading student responses is costly and time-consuming. Moreover, human annotators are prone to bias, fatigue, and rater drift, which further limits grading reliability. Various methods have been employed to develop automated essay scoring (AES) systems to reduce these costs and address bias-related issues. These methods range from early text-feature-based systems to current machine-learning and transformer-based models. Specifically, large language models (LLMs) offer the potential to streamline the development of AES systems. However, they are subject to well-known limitations, such as hallucinations and prompt sensitivity. This creates a need to explore the potential of a mixed-methods approach that leverages the synergies among individual LLMs through ensemble formation. We evaluate the potential of ensembles of LLMs to match human-rater agreement when grading student responses in economics and medical education across 103 criteria. We use 631 German-language responses and corresponding human ratings by 2 to 5 annotators from a previously conducted assessment. We experiment with 523 rubric-based prompt configurations across 15 open-weight LLMs and assess their consistency with human raters using Krippendorff's alpha for inter-annotator agreement (IAA) and the Alternative Annotator Test (alt-test). Our results show that replacing one human rater with the best-performing LLM--prompt configuration maintains or improves IAA for 91 of the 103 criteria and that LLMs pass the alt-test for 90 criteria. Our findings suggest that current state-of-the-art LLMs can support AES of German responses in economics and medical education, reducing human workload and enabling faster processing, while validation against human ratings remains necessary.
items.abstract_zh: 对学生回答进行评分成本高且耗时。此外，人工标注者容易产生偏差、疲劳和评分者漂移，这进一步限制了评分的可靠性。已有多种方法用于开发自动作文评分（AES）系统，以降低这些成本并解决与偏差相关的问题。这些方法从早期基于文本特征的系统到当前的机器学习和基于Transformer的模型不等。具体而言，大语言模型（LLM）具有简化AES系统开发的潜力。然而，它们存在众所周知的局限性，例如幻觉和提示敏感性。因此需要探索一种混合方法的潜力，该方法通过集成形成来利用各个LLM之间的协同效应。我们评估LLM集成在经济学和医学教育中按照103项标准对学生回答进行评分时匹配人工评分者一致性的潜力。我们使用631份德语回答以及来自先前一项评估的、由2至5名标注者给出的对应人工评分。我们在15个开放权重LLM上实验了523种基于评分量规的提示配置，并使用用于标注者间一致性（IAA）的Krippendorff's alpha和替代标注者测试（alt-test）评估其与人工评分者的一致性。我们的结果表明，用表现最佳的LLM--提示配置替代一名人工评分者，在103项标准中的91项上保持或提高了IAA，并且LLM在90项标准上通过了alt-test。我们的发现表明，当前最先进的LLM可以支持经济学和医学教育中德语回答的AES，减少人工工作量并实现更快的处理，同时仍需要针对人工评分进行验证。

items.title_en: TacBridge: Learning Unified Tactile Representations through Cross-Sensor Correspondence
items.title_zh: TacBridge：通过跨传感器对应关系学习统一触觉表征
items.abstract_en: Optical tactile sensors record tactile videos that capture local deformation and its temporal evolution during contact, supporting robot manipulation, force estimation, and tactile representation learning. Differences in imaging geometry, background appearance, illumination, resolution, and deformation response lead to sensor-dependent observations of the same contact across GelSight, DIGIT, GelSlim, TacTip, and other optical tactile sensors. This variability limits representation transfer and the joint use of multi-sensor data. We introduce TacBridge, a framework for learning unified representations from multi-sensor tactile videos through cross-sensor correspondence. Specifically, multi-sensor masked tactile-video pre-training learns spatiotemporal representations across sensors. We then train the same masked model jointly on same-sensor and cross-sensor reconstruction, using paired source and target videos of matched contact events. Experiments on cross-sensor translation and downstream perception demonstrate the cross-sensor generalization and task transferability of the learned tactile representations.
items.abstract_zh: 光学触觉传感器记录触觉视频，捕获接触过程中的局部变形及其时间演化，支持机器人操作、力估计和触觉表征学习。成像几何、背景外观、光照、分辨率和变形响应的差异，导致GelSight、DIGIT、GelSlim、TacTip及其他光学触觉传感器对同一接触产生依赖传感器的观测。这种变异性限制了表征迁移和多传感器数据的联合使用。我们提出TacBridge，一个通过跨传感器对应关系从多传感器触觉视频中学习统一表征的框架。具体而言，多传感器掩码触觉视频预训练学习跨传感器的时空表征。然后，我们使用匹配接触事件的成对源视频和目标视频，在同一传感器和跨传感器重建上联合训练同一个掩码模型。跨传感器转换和下游感知的实验证明了所学触觉表征的跨传感器泛化能力和任务可迁移性。

items.title_en: DoF-Query Transformer for Adaptive Fusion of Egocentric Vision and Forearm HD-sEMG in Continuous Hand Kinematics
items.title_zh: 用于连续手部运动学中第一人称视觉与前臂HD-sEMG自适应融合的DoF-Query Transformer
items.abstract_en: Continuous and accurate estimation of human hand kinematics is important not only for intuitive human-machine interaction, but also for capturing fine-grained human manipulation demonstrations that can provide action supervision for embodied-intelligence datasets and dexterous robot learning. However, individual sensing modalities may be insufficient for reliable estimation under varying operating conditions. We present a finger-unencumbered multimodal framework for continuous regression of 20 hand joint angles from egocentric RGB images and 128-channel forearm high-density surface electromyography (HD-sEMG). The framework combines a Vision Transformer-based visual encoder, a Transformer-based EMG encoder, and a degree of freedom (DoF) query Transformer fusion decoder. To account for the varying informativeness of visual and EMG cues across joint DoFs and input conditions, the decoder assigns a separate learnable query to each DoF, enabling DoF-specific and context-adaptive fusion of the two modalities. The framework was evaluated on synchronized multimodal data from 10 participants. Averaged across participants, the proposed fusion model achieved a mean coefficient of determination ($R^2$) of $0.88$ and a mean absolute error (MAE) of $2.80^\circ$, compared with $0.82$ and $3.21^\circ$ for the vision-only model and $0.68$ and $5.13^\circ$ for the EMG-only model. It also outperformed the evaluated representative unimodal baselines and alternative fusion designs. DoF-wise analyses showed larger fusion gains for visually ambiguous joints and viewing conditions, while synthetic visual occlusion demonstrated greater robustness than vision-only estimation. These results highlight the complementary value of egocentric vision and forearm HD-sEMG for capturing fine-grained human hand kinematics, with potential applications in human demonstration acquisition and dexterous robot learning.
items.abstract_zh: 连续且准确估计人手运动学不仅对直观的人机交互很重要，而且对捕获细粒度的人类操作演示也很重要，这些演示可为具身智能数据集和灵巧机器人学习提供动作监督。然而，在变化的操作条件下，单一传感模态可能不足以进行可靠估计。我们提出一种手指无束缚的多模态框架，用于从第一人称RGB图像和128通道前臂高密度表面肌电（HD-sEMG）连续回归20个手部关节角度。该框架结合了基于Vision Transformer的视觉编码器、基于Transformer的EMG编码器以及自由度（DoF）查询Transformer融合解码器。为了考虑视觉和EMG线索在不同关节DoF和输入条件下的信息量变化，解码器为每个DoF分配一个单独的可学习查询，从而实现两种模态的DoF特定且上下文自适应的融合。该框架在来自10名参与者的同步多模态数据上进行了评估。在参与者间平均，所提出的融合模型达到平均决定系数（$R^2$）$0.88$和平均绝对误差（MAE）$2.80^\circ$，而仅视觉模型为$0.82$和$3.21^\circ$，仅EMG模型为$0.68$和$5.13^\circ$。它还优于所评估的代表性单模态基线和替代融合设计。按DoF分析显示，对于视觉上模糊的关节和观看条件，融合增益更大，而合成视觉遮挡表现出比仅视觉估计更强的鲁棒性。这些结果突出了第一人称视觉和前臂HD-sEMG在捕获细粒度人手运动学方面的互补价值，并可能在人类演示采集和灵巧机器人学习中具有应用。

items.title_en: Multi-Assay Antibody Developability Prediction with Shared Structure-Language Representations
items.title_zh: 具有共享结构-语言表征的多测定抗体可开发性预测
items.abstract_en: Early assessment of antibody developability is critical in drug discovery, but computational approaches remain limited by the scarcity of experimental data. We explore two strategies for working within that limit. First, we designed per-residue physicochemical descriptors encoding the local structural environment, including new terms such as directional charge asymmetry and screened electrostatic potential. These feed a convolutional network, combined with protein language model (PLM) embeddings in a two-stream architecture: the two are encoded and predicted independently and merged only at the prediction stage. Second, a shared trunk with per-assay heads passes information between related assays. Both are implemented in the Multi-Assay Developability Model (MADM) and evaluated on eight assays: HIC, heparin affinity (HAC), AC-SINS, and polyspecificity ELISA against BVP, dsDNA, insulin, ovalbumin and soluble membrane proteins (SMP), with labels from 29 open sources. Structural descriptors match or exceed PLM embeddings (AbLang2, ESM2) on several assays; combining the streams gives a small but consistent gain in accuracy and reduces seed-to-seed variance. Multi-assay training raises Spearman rho for ovalbumin and SMP by about 0.1, where assays correlate and share sequence space. Under cluster-split cross-validation the strongest results are for HAC, ovalbumin, insulin, SMP and HIC (rho = 0.70-0.82); AC-SINS, BVP and dsDNA are weaker (0.50-0.55). In these three, sequence clusters largely coincide with data source, so a held-out fold measures transfer to differently calibrated measurements as well as to new sequences. On the 80-antibody GDPa3 hold-out, performance falls by rho around 0.1 for all but SMP (0.22). Transfer to the VHH panel of Ginkgo GDPa5 gives comparable results, and scFv validation against binary SMP labels yields F1 = 0.89, AUC = 0.95.
items.abstract_zh: 抗体可开发性的早期评估在药物发现中至关重要，但计算方法仍受实验数据稀缺的限制。我们探索了在该限制下开展工作的两种策略。首先，我们设计了编码局部结构环境的逐残基物理化学描述符，包括方向电荷不对称性和屏蔽静电势等新项。这些描述符输入卷积网络，并在双流架构中与蛋白质语言模型（PLM）嵌入结合：两者独立编码和预测，仅在预测阶段合并。其次，带各测定专属头的共享主干在相关测定之间传递信息。两者均在多测定可开发性模型（MADM）中实现，并在八项测定上评估：HIC、肝素亲和力（HAC）、AC-SINS，以及针对BVP、dsDNA、胰岛素、卵清蛋白和可溶性膜蛋白（SMP）的多特异性ELISA，标签来自29个开放来源。结构描述符在若干测定上达到或超过PLM嵌入（AbLang2、ESM2）；结合两条流在准确率上带来小而一致的提升，并降低种子间方差。多测定训练将卵清蛋白和SMP的Spearman rho提高约0.1，这些测定相互关联并共享序列空间。在聚类划分交叉验证下，最强结果出现在HAC、卵清蛋白、胰岛素、SMP和HIC（rho = 0.70-0.82）；AC-SINS、BVP和dsDNA较弱（0.50-0.55）。在这三项中，序列聚类在很大程度上与数据来源重合，因此留出折同时衡量向不同校准测量以及新序列的迁移。在80个抗体的GDPa3留出集上，除SMP（0.22）外，所有测定的性能下降约rho 0.1。迁移到Ginkgo GDPa5的VHH面板得到可比结果，针对二值SMP标签的scFv验证得到F1 = 0.89、AUC = 0.95。

items.title_en: Collective coupling of over 100 individually trapped atoms to a single cavity mode
items.title_zh: 将超过100个单独捕获的原子集体耦合到单一腔模
items.abstract_en: Coupling optical tweezer arrays to high-finesse cavities provides a shared optical interface for neutral-atom registers. Scaling this interface to large tweezer arrays requires placing many traps within the coupling region of a single cavity mode while maintaining uniform trapping and site-resolved detection. Here we match a two-dimensional array of 192 optical tweezers to the coupling profile of a millimeter-scale Fabry-Perot cavity. To improve trap uniformity in the array generated by crossed acousto-optic deflectors, we combine optimization with optical feedback and atomic fluorescence feedback, achieving a mean cesium loading probability of approximately 58%. In each trial, fluorescence imaging determines whether each individual tweezer site is occupied, allowing the cavity transmission spectra to be grouped by atom number. The grouped spectra exhibit resolved normal-mode doublets, and the group with 120 imaged atoms yields an effective collective coupling of $G_{\mathrm{eff}}/(2π) = 21.30 \pm 0.23$ MHz. A model based on the calculated coupling profile and measured site loading probabilities predicts that the mean squared coupling per occupied site changes little between 97 and 120 atoms. The fitted collective coupling is therefore consistent with square-root scaling with atom number despite the spatial variation in single-atom coupling. These results provide an experimental basis for studying photon-mediated many-body dynamics and developing cavity-assisted readout and optical links between neutral-atom registers.
items.abstract_zh: 将光镊阵列耦合到高精细度腔为中子原子寄存器提供共享光学接口。将该接口扩展到大型光镊阵列，需要在单一腔模的耦合区域内放置许多陷阱，同时保持均匀捕获和位点分辨探测。在此，我们将192个光镊的二维阵列匹配到毫米级Fabry-Perot腔的耦合分布。为提高由交叉声光偏转器生成的阵列中的陷阱均匀性，我们将优化与光学反馈和原子荧光反馈相结合，实现约58%的平均铯装载概率。在每次试验中，荧光成像确定每个单独光镊位点是否被占据，从而可以按原子数对腔透射光谱进行分组。分组后的光谱显示出可分辨的简正模双峰，具有120个成像原子的组给出有效集体耦合 $G_{\mathrm{eff}}/(2π) = 21.30 \pm 0.23$ MHz。基于计算得到的耦合分布和测得的位点装载概率的模型预测，每个被占据位点的均方耦合在97到120个原子之间变化很小。因此，尽管单原子耦合存在空间变化，拟合的集体耦合与随原子数平方根缩放一致。这些结果为研究光子介导的多体动力学以及开发腔辅助读出和中性原子寄存器之间的光学链路提供了实验基础。

items.title_en: Deep Learning for Physicists: From Linear Regression to Reasoning Models
items.title_zh: 面向物理学家的深度学习：从线性回归到推理模型
items.abstract_en: These lecture notes are based on an introductory course on neural networks and deep learning that the author taught in the School of Mathematical Sciences at Queen Mary University of London in 2023/24 and 2024/25. The author, however, is a physicist, and it shows: wherever possible, ideas are explained with physical intuition rather than heavy formalism. Readers with a background in physics or mathematics who want a self-contained, introductory route into modern machine learning may therefore find these notes particularly friendly. The notes start from maximum likelihood, least squares, linear regression and (stochastic) gradient descent. They then cover neural networks, backpropagation, the vanishing gradient problem, batch and layer normalization, overfitting and regularization, adversarial examples, and the kernel method. The second half turns to natural language processing: word embeddings, recurrent networks and LSTMs, the attention mechanism and Transformers, and large language models, including scaling laws, the history of GPT, instruction tuning, reinforcement learning from human feedback, hallucination, alignment faking, chain-of-thought reasoning and test-time scaling. The emphasis on large language models reflects requests from the students. The notes are aimed at third- and fourth-year students in the UK system. Because the course was also taken by students from other departments, very little is assumed: even basic material such as matrix multiplication is explained from scratch, so readers familiar with it can safely skip such parts. No originality is claimed; the aim is a coherent, intuitive path through the material. Developments after spring 2025 are not covered, but the basic ideas emphasized here are unlikely to go out of date soon.
items.abstract_zh: 这些讲义基于作者于2023/24和2024/25学年在伦敦玛丽女王大学数学科学学院讲授的神经网络与深度学习入门课程。然而，作者是一名物理学家，这一点显而易见：在可能的情况下，概念通过物理直觉而非繁重形式体系来解释。因此，具有物理或数学背景、希望获得通往现代机器学习的自包含入门路径的读者，可能会发现这些讲义特别友好。讲义从最大似然、最小二乘、线性回归和（随机）梯度下降开始。然后涵盖神经网络、反向传播、梯度消失问题、批归一化和层归一化、过拟合与正则化、对抗样本以及核方法。后半部分转向自然语言处理：词嵌入、循环网络和LSTM、注意力机制和Transformer，以及大语言模型，包括缩放定律、GPT的历史、指令微调、基于人类反馈的强化学习、幻觉、对齐伪装、思维链推理和测试时缩放。对大语言模型的强调反映了学生的要求。这些讲义面向英国学制中的三年级和四年级学生。由于该课程也有其他院系的学生选修，因此假设的前置知识很少：甚至矩阵乘法等基础材料也从零开始解释，所以熟悉这些内容的读者可以放心跳过这些部分。不主张原创性；目标是提供一条连贯、直观的材料学习路径。2025年春季之后的进展未涵盖，但此处强调的基本思想不太可能很快过时。

items.title_en: Seeing Isn't Resolving: Visual and Linguistic Disambiguation with Conversational Grounding
items.title_zh: 看见不等于解决：基于对话锚定的视觉与语言消歧
items.abstract_en: Visual grounding benchmarks usually do not consider the contextual uncertainty of real-world scenarios. In this study, we construct a novel benchmark, the Japanese evaluation for Ambiguous visual Grounding with Dialogue (JAG-D) dataset. It consists of human-robot conversational multimodal interactions covering different types of ambiguity, arising from visual and linguistic categories. We evaluate the capabilities of different state-of-the-art Visual Language Models (VLMs) for ambiguity recognition and resolution. We compare dialogue context grounding performance for visual and linguistic ambiguity resolution. Our experiments show that VLMs can substantially improve the resolution of linguistic ambiguity, especially Japanese zero anaphora, by using dialogue context. We further conduct a comparative analysis to understand whether grounding improvements arise from the semantic content of the dialogue or from its conversational structure.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉定位基准通常不考虑真实场景中的上下文不确定性。在本研究中，我们构建了一个新基准——日语歧义视觉定位对话评估（JAG-D）数据集。它由人机对话多模态交互组成，涵盖由视觉和语言类别引起的不同类型歧义。我们评估了不同最先进视觉语言模型（VLM）在歧义识别与消解方面的能力。我们比较了对话上下文定位在视觉和语言歧义消解上的表现。实验表明，VLM利用对话上下文可以显著提升语言歧义的消解，尤其是日语零回指。我们进一步进行了对比分析，以理解定位改进是来自对话的语义内容还是来自其对话结构。

items.title_en: Learning and Verifying Progress: Closed-Loop Agentic Planning with Progress-Enhanced Execution for Long-Horizon Vision-Language Navigation
items.title_zh: 学习并验证进度：面向长时程视觉语言导航的闭环智能体规划与进度增强执行
items.abstract_en: Long-horizon vision-language navigation (VLN) requires agents to track instruction progress and recover from local errors before they propagate across subtasks. However, executors trained on expert trajectories encounter policy-induced state shifts during deployment, and their stop signals do not reliably indicate subtask completion. We introduce Learning and Verifying Progress for VLN (LeaP-VLN), an agentic VLN system that couples progress-aware execution with independent progress verification through plan--execute--verify--recover cycles. LeaP-VLN leverages progress both explicitly, through a progress verifier that verifies subtask completion before the agent advances and triggers dual-phase recovery upon route deviation, and implicitly, by co-training the executor on progress reasoning and action prediction to enhance the executor's progress awareness and corrective control. To adapt the executor to this closed-loop interface, we propose a two-stage progress-enhanced curriculum: behavior cloning on expert demonstrations, followed by joint training on demonstrations, expert action corrections, and progress-reasoning supervision. Policy-generated trajectories expose the executor to both intra-subtask drift and inter-subtask state shifts, aligning training with the deviations encountered during closed-loop execution. Extensive experiments on R2R-CE and RxR-CE demonstrate state-of-the-art success rates among monocular methods trained without additional navigation datasets, while real-world experiments further validate the effectiveness of LeaP-VLN in long-horizon navigation.
items.abstract_zh: 长时程视觉语言导航（VLN）要求智能体跟踪指令进度，并在局部错误传播到子任务之前从局部错误中恢复。然而，在专家轨迹上训练的执行器在部署过程中会遇到策略引起的状态偏移，并且其停止信号不能可靠地指示子任务完成。我们提出了面向VLN的学习与验证进度（LeaP-VLN），这是一种智能体VLN系统，通过“规划—执行—验证—恢复”循环将进度感知执行与独立的进度验证相结合。LeaP-VLN既显式地利用进度——通过进度验证器在智能体推进之前验证子任务完成，并在路线偏离时触发双阶段恢复；也隐式地利用进度——通过在进度推理和动作预测上联合训练执行器，以增强执行器的进度意识和纠正控制。为使执行器适应这种闭环接口，我们提出了一种两阶段进度增强课程：先在专家演示上进行行为克隆，然后在演示、专家动作纠正和进度推理监督上进行联合训练。策略生成的轨迹使执行器同时暴露于子任务内漂移和子任务间状态偏移，从而使训练与闭环执行期间遇到的偏差对齐。在R2R-CE和RxR-CE上的大量实验表明，在未使用额外导航数据集训练的单目方法中，该方法取得了最先进的成功率，而真实世界实验进一步验证了LeaP-VLN在长时程导航中的有效性。

items.title_en: Unlocking Cross-Attention in Label-Scarce Regimes: A Weakly Supervised Approach for Video Semantic Segmentation
items.title_zh: 在标签稀缺场景中释放交叉注意力：一种用于视频语义分割的弱监督方法
items.abstract_en: Weakly Supervised Video Semantic Segmentation (WS-VSS) aims to learn temporally consistent semantic object masks in videos using only video-level labels. While fully supervised models successfully learn temporal relationships by means of cross-attention, training these temporal weights under weak supervision is unstable and even pushes the model below its single-frame baseline. Therefore, existing WS-VSS methods exploit temporal consistency by relying on external priors, such as optical flow. Unfortunately these cues are non-semantic, computationally expensive and noisy, degrading the supervisory signal. Instead of supervising attention weights directly or using external priors, we propose MemCAM, a WS-VSS transformer framework that learns temporal cross-attention directly through feature-space self-supervision. MemCAM introduces a CAM Propagation Algorithm that synthesizes a supervisory signal by propagating past CAMs according to patch-level feature similarities in the latent space. Specifically, we constrain their induced CAMs through a consistency objective between predicted and propagated maps, stabilizing temporal attention learning. Experiments on the YouTube-Objects v2.2 and WS$^2$ datasets demonstrate that MemCAM consistently outperforms the temporal localization and segmentation performance of WS-VSS alternatives, showing that cross-attention can be effectively trained in label-scarce video settings through internal self-supervision.
items.abstract_zh: 弱监督视频语义分割（WS-VSS）旨在仅使用视频级标签学习视频中时间一致的语义对象掩码。完全监督模型通过交叉注意力成功学习时间关系，而在弱监督下训练这些时间权重不稳定，甚至会使模型低于其单帧基线。因此，现有WS-VSS方法依赖外部先验（如光流）来利用时间一致性。不幸的是，这些线索是非语义的、计算昂贵且含噪，会降低监督信号。我们提出MemCAM，一种WS-VSS Transformer框架，不直接监督注意力权重或使用外部先验，而是通过特征空间自监督直接学习时间交叉注意力。MemCAM引入CAM传播算法，该算法根据潜在空间中块级特征相似性传播过去的CAM来合成监督信号。具体而言，我们通过预测图与传播图之间的一致性目标约束其诱导的CAM，从而稳定时间注意力学习。在YouTube-Objects v2.2和WS$^2$数据集上的实验表明，MemCAM在时间定位和分割性能上持续优于WS-VSS替代方法，表明可以通过内部自监督在标签稀缺的视频设置中有效训练交叉注意力。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为语言模型与推理，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Vision-Language Models Reproduce a Human Mental-Extrapolation Bias in the Watanabe Illusion
items.title_zh: 视觉语言模型复现渡边错觉中的人类心理外推偏差
items.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used for visual judgments, yet whether they share human perceptual biases, and where in the model such biases arise, is unclear. We addressed this with the Watanabe Illusion, a stimulus not previously studied quantitatively: an oblique segment inside a circle whose extension geometrically hits the topmost of 11 dots, yet human observers (n = 131) reported a dot near the middle of the column. Five VLMs (Qwen2.5-VL-32B and 7B, Claude Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5.5 Instant, Gemini 3.5 Flash), given the identical stimulus and wording, all deviated in the same direction. In the open-weight Qwen2.5-VL-32B, linear probes on the vision encoder recovered the line angle and the target dot six to eight times more accurately than its behavioral responses. A layer-wise logit lens showed that the correct answer dominates in the middle layers of the language model and is overwritten in late layers only under a visual-judgment frame. Naming the illusion, requesting suppression of prior knowledge, forcing a visual chain of thought, and 390 semantic preambles left the response center unchanged; only disclosing the correct answer moved it. VLMs may therefore carry human perceptual biases at the language-generation stage, where they resist declarative correction.
items.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）日益用于视觉判断，但它们是否具有与人类相同的知觉偏差、偏差位于模型何处仍不清楚。我们借助此前未被定量研究的渡边错觉来探究：圆内一条斜线段的几何延长线恰好经过 11 个点中最上方的一点，但人类被试（n=131）却报告看到接近该列中部的一点。五个 VLM（Qwen2.5-VL-32B 与 7B、Claude Sonnet 4.6、GPT-5.5 Instant、Gemini 3.5 Flash）在相同刺激与措辞下全部朝同一方向偏离。在开源 Qwen2.5-VL-32B 中，对视觉编码器的线性探针恢复线段角度与目标点的准确率比其行为回答高 6–8 倍；逐层 logit lens 显示正确答案在中间层占优，仅在“视觉判断”框架下于后层被覆盖。命名错觉、要求抑制先验、强制视觉思维链以及 390 条语义前言都未改变回答中心，只有直接告知正确答案才会移动。因此 VLM 可能在语言生成阶段携带人类知觉偏差，且难以通过陈述性纠正消除。
items.highlight_zh: VLM 复现人类错觉偏差，且偏差出现在语言生成阶段
items.digest_zh:
【问题】视觉语言模型越来越多被用来“看图作答”，但它们会不会像人一样犯系统性的知觉错误？如果会，这种偏差出现在模型的哪个部分？

【方法】作者用一个此前未被定量研究过的经典视错觉——渡边错觉：圆里有一条斜线段，把这条线几何延长出去，恰好穿过一列 11 个点中最上面那个点；但 131 名人类被试普遍报告看到的是靠近该列中间的点，也就是说人脑在“外推”时把线看偏了。作者把完全相同的图形和相同的问法喂给五个主流 VLM。

【结果】五个模型全部朝与人类相同的方向偏离。作者进一步解剖开源模型 Qwen2.5-VL-32B：对视觉编码器表示做线性探针，能以比模型最终回答高 6–8 倍的准确率读出线段角度和目标点，说明模型“看到”的其实是对的；逐层 logit lens 显示正确答案在语言模型中间层一度占优，只在以“视觉判断”的形式作答时，才被后面的层覆盖掉。各种提示干预——点破这是错觉、要求忽略先验知识、要求视觉思维链、换 390 条不同的开场语——都没能把回答拉回中心，只有直接告知正确答案才有效。

【为何重要】这说明模型可能继承了人类式的知觉偏差，而且偏差不在感知环节而在“作答”环节，靠提示词难以纠正。对把 VLM 用于测量、图像审阅等需要客观判断的场景，这是重要警示，也提示需要更强的可解释与干预手段。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Ternary-Valued FDTD Method for Nonlinear Optics: Third-Harmonic Generation on a Multiplier-Free Solver
items.title_zh: 非线性光学的三值FDTD方法：无乘法器求解器上的三次谐波产生
items.abstract_en: I show that a finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) solver with field variables restricted to the ternary alphabet $\{-1,0,+1\}$ can reproduce nonlinear optical physics quantitatively on both CPUs and field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs). Building on the general ternary-valued FDTD algorithm, in which each Yee cell stores an integer state that accumulates the discrete curl of neighbouring symbols without being drained, I extend the scheme to inhomogeneous and Kerr media and to Mur absorbing boundaries, without performing any multiplication operations. Dielectric contrast is implemented as a multiplexer, since the difference between ternary symbols takes only a few values, the instantaneous Kerr nonlinearity as a coefficient look-up table and the Mur boundary coefficients as canonical signed-digit shift--add chains. The scheme reproduces the third-harmonic conversion efficiency of a floating-point reference to within $1.4\%$. A symmetry of the governing physics, expressed through the even harmonics forbidden by centrosymmetric $χ^{(3)}$, provides a reference-free self-check for both ternary and floating-point models. The complete solver fits on a small, low-cost FPGA and contains no multiplier anywhere in its datapath, placing nonlinear optical modelling within reach of embedded and autonomous platforms rather than of high-performance computers.
items.abstract_zh: 我表明，将场变量限制为三值字母表{-1,0,+1}的有限差分时域（FDTD）求解器，可以在CPU和现场可编程门阵列（FPGA）上定量复现非线性光学物理。基于一般的三值FDTD算法（其中每个Yee单元存储一个整数状态，该状态累积相邻符号的离散旋度而不会被泄放），我将该方案扩展到非均匀介质和Kerr介质以及Mur吸收边界，同时不执行任何乘法操作。介电对比度被实现为多路复用器，因为三值符号之间的差值只取少数几个值；瞬态Kerr非线性被实现为系数查找表；Mur边界系数被实现为规范符号数字移位—加法链。该方案将浮点参考的三次谐波转换效率复现到1.4%以内。控制物理的一种对称性——通过中心对称χ(3)所禁止的偶次谐波体现——为三值模型和浮点模型提供了一种无参考自检。完整求解器可适配于小型低成本FPGA，并且其数据通路中任何位置都不包含乘法器，从而使非线性光学建模可触及嵌入式与自主平台，而非高性能计算机。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生物建模与实验，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: SemiNovo: Learning Beyond Search-Identified Spectra for De Novo Peptide Sequencing
items.title_zh: SemiNovo：超越搜索识别谱图的从头肽段测序学习
items.abstract_en: Sensitive peptide identification is fundamental to protein characterization and novel protein discovery, for which de novo peptide sequencing (DNPS) from tandem mass spectra provides an important database-independent approach. Although deep learning has substantially advanced de novo sequencing, existing models are predominantly trained on high-confidence peptide-spectrum matches obtained through database search. This search-conditioned supervision excludes a large fraction of unidentified spectra, creating a distribution mismatch between the selectively labeled training data and the complete spectrum stream encountered at inference time, thereby limiting peptide identification performance. To address this challenge, we propose SemiNovo, a semi-supervised framework that learns jointly from identified and unlabeled spectra. SemiNovo first constructs DarkSpec, a large-scale quality-controlled corpus of unlabeled spectra collected from diverse public proteomics projects, thereby extending training beyond search-identified spectra and mitigating the resulting shift in DNPS supervision. It then combines stepwise mass-constrained autoregressive decoding with cumulative path confidence to derive reliable supervision from unlabeled spectra. Moreover, SemiNovo introduces head-wise chemical-evidence gating to improve spectral evidence aggregation under noisy and incomplete fragmentation. Experiments show that SemiNovo performs favorably against state-of-the-art methods on multiple benchmarks. Code and dataset are publicly available.
items.abstract_zh: 灵敏的肽段鉴定是蛋白质表征和新蛋白质发现的基础，为此，基于串联质谱的从头肽段测序（DNPS）提供了一种重要的不依赖数据库的方法。尽管深度学习已大幅推进从头测序，但现有模型主要在以数据库搜索获得的高置信度肽段—谱图匹配上训练。这种以搜索为条件的监督排除了很大一部分未鉴定谱图，造成选择性标注的训练数据与推理时遇到的完整谱图流之间的分布失配，从而限制了肽段鉴定性能。为应对这一挑战，我们提出SemiNovo，一个从已鉴定谱图和未标注谱图联合学习的半监督框架。SemiNovo首先构建DarkSpec，这是一个大规模、经过质量控制的未标注谱图语料库，收集自多个公共蛋白质组学项目，从而将训练扩展到搜索识别谱图之外，并缓解由此产生的DNPS监督偏移。然后，它结合逐步质量约束的自回归解码与累积路径置信度，从无标注谱图中获得可靠监督。此外，SemiNovo引入按头化学证据门控，以在噪声和不完整碎裂条件下改进谱图证据聚合。实验表明，SemiNovo在多个基准上优于最先进方法。代码和数据集已公开。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Living Context Graphs: Continual Semantic Learning for Enterprise Data Reasoning
items.title_zh: 活上下文图：面向企业数据推理的持续语义学习
items.abstract_en: Enterprise AI can now perform analytics, reporting, and data-driven workflows, yet the data foundations it relies on remain hard to operationalize: business meaning, relationships, metric definitions, and reporting conventions are absent from database schemas and scattered across undocumented systems and tribal knowledge. We introduce the Living Context Graph (LCG), a continually learned context layer that makes existing enterprise data operational for AI without requiring a copy or transformation of the underlying warehouse. LCG bootstraps base semantics and relationships from the data itself, builds a concept graph that indexes business context as queries are served, writes durable semantic learnings from verified outcomes, and withdraws or re-earns context when later outcomes contradict prior routes. We evaluate LCG through text-to-SQL, a core data-reasoning task, on a transfer-aware split of three BIRD databases comprising 499 questions: 353 form the learning history and 146 are held out and never used to update the context layer. Bootstrapping alone improves overall accuracy by +4.6 percentage points. Learning only from the history raises accuracy on the untouched held-out transfer set by +22.6 points (95% CI [+14.4, +30.8]), exceeding five-shot retrieval from the same history by +12.3 points. Incremental learning reaches the one-shot endpoint within observed evaluation noise on every database. Ablating the graph changes held-out accuracy by at most one question per database but increases per-query cost 2.3-3.3x and median latency 1.8-3.4x: continually learned semantics drive accuracy, while the graph makes that context efficient to serve.
items.abstract_zh: 企业AI现在可以执行分析、报告和数据驱动的工作流，但其依赖的数据基础仍然难以操作化：业务含义、关系、指标定义和报告惯例在数据库模式中缺失，并分散在未记录的系统与部落知识中。我们引入活上下文图（LCG），这是一个持续学习的上下文层，使现有企业数据对AI可操作，而无需复制或转换底层数据仓库。LCG从数据本身引导基础语义和关系，构建概念图，在查询服务过程中索引业务上下文，从已验证结果写入持久语义学习，并在后续结果与先前路径矛盾时撤回或重新获得上下文。我们通过文本到SQL这一核心数据推理任务，在三个BIRD数据库的迁移感知划分（共499个问题）上评估LCG：353个构成学习历史，146个被保留且从不用于更新上下文层。仅引导就将整体准确率提高4.6个百分点。仅从历史学习使未触碰的保留迁移集准确率提高22.6点（95% CI [14.4, 30.8]），超过从同一历史进行五样本检索12.3点。增量学习在每个数据库上都在观测到的评估噪声范围内达到单样本端点。消融图对保留准确率的影响每个数据库至多一个问题，但使每次查询成本增加2.3–3.3倍、中位延迟增加1.8–3.4倍：持续学习的语义驱动准确率，而图使该上下文服务更高效。

items.title_en: Vision-Language Grounded Semantic Navigation for Autonomous Mobile Robots
items.title_zh: 面向自主移动机器人的视觉语言锚定语义导航
items.abstract_en: Language-guided navigation enables mobile robots to interpret natural language commands and navigate toward user-specified targets in unstructured environments. However, integrating open-vocabulary visual perception with classical robotics pipelines for mapping and navigation remains a challenging problem. In this work, we present a complete ROS2-based system that combines frontier-based exploration, open-vocabulary object detection using Grounding DINO, depth-based 3D localization, and semantic mapping to enable end-to-end vision-language grounded navigation in simulation. The system accepts natural language commands such as ``go to the yellow box,'' detects candidate objects from RGB images using text prompts, estimates their positions in the world frame, and generates navigation goals executed by the Nav2 stack. In a Gazebo-based indoor environment with a TurtleBot3 robot, the system autonomously explored the room, detected three of the five target objects, and successfully executed both natural language navigation commands tested, without task-specific training. The results indicate that open-vocabulary grounding models can be integrated into classical navigation pipelines, though performance is limited by detection uncertainty, depth-based localization error, and incomplete exploration coverage. These findings highlight both the feasibility and current limitations of deploying vision-language grounded navigation systems using lightweight, CPU-only architectures.
items.abstract_zh: 语言引导导航使移动机器人能够解释自然语言命令，并在非结构化环境中朝用户指定目标导航。然而，将开放词汇视觉感知与用于建图和导航的经典机器人流水线集成仍然是一个具有挑战性的问题。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个完整的基于ROS2的系统，它结合了基于前沿的探索、使用Grounding DINO的开放词汇目标检测、基于深度的3D定位和语义建图，以在仿真中实现端到端的视觉语言锚定导航。系统接受诸如“去黄色盒子”的自然语言命令，使用文本提示从RGB图像中检测候选对象，估计它们在世界坐标系中的位置，并生成由Nav2栈执行的导航目标。在配备TurtleBot3机器人的基于Gazebo的室内环境中，系统自主探索了房间，检测到五个目标对象中的三个，并成功执行了两个测试的自然语言导航命令，且无需任务特定训练。结果表明，开放词汇锚定模型可以集成到经典导航流水线中，但性能受到检测不确定性、基于深度的定位误差和不完整探索覆盖的限制。这些发现既突出了使用轻量级、仅CPU架构部署视觉语言锚定导航系统的可行性，也说明了当前局限性。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为检测与跟踪，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: TelePhysica: Agentic Reconstruction of Physically Interactive Scenes
items.title_zh: TelePhysica：物理交互场景的智能体式重建
items.abstract_en: Direct image-to-video diffusion models entangle pixel synthesis with implicit latent motion, precluding persistent 3D mechanical equilibrium, mid-rollout intervention, and counterfactual force control. Conversely, single-pass programmatic 3D reconstruction from an uncalibrated photograph leaves monocular depth and support clearance underconstrained, causing reconstructed scenes to interpenetrate or collapse under gravity. We present TelePhysica, a closed-loop framework that reconstructs an executable, multi-regime physical world from a single photograph to drive stateful 3D interaction and trajectory-grounded video synthesis. A vision-language coding agent synthesizes separable visual meshes and declarative physical models within a two-stage verification loop that pairs pixel-aligned silhouette critique with a zero-force gravitational equilibrium preflight. The verified world compiles into a unified solver coupling rigid bodies, articulated chains, co-dimensional cloth shells, and 3D tetrahedral elastodynamics, whose simulated rollouts condition pretrained video diffusion models through pixel-aligned structural streams. On a 100-scene single-image benchmark, closed-loop execution raises equilibrium-verified world recovery from $0\%$ in single-pass synthesis to $81\%$. Controlled constitutive ablations show over an order-of-magnitude larger localized corner displacement and out-of-plane pleating in finite-element cloth than in matched rigid-plate proxies. Conditioning video diffusion on simulated trajectories increases dynamic motion-mask overlap by $2{\times}\text{--}5{\times}$ and preserves motion direction under counterfactual force reversals where direct image-to-video models fail.
items.abstract_zh: 直接图像到视频扩散模型将像素合成与隐式潜在运动纠缠在一起，使持久的3D力学平衡、推演中途干预和反事实力控制无法实现。相反，从未标定照片进行单遍程序化3D重建会使单目深度和支撑间隙约束不足，导致重建场景相互穿透或在重力下坍塌。我们提出TelePhysica，一个闭环框架，可从单张照片重建可执行的多物理机制世界，以驱动有状态3D交互和基于轨迹的视频合成。一个视觉-语言编码智能体在两阶段验证循环内合成可分离视觉网格和声明式物理模型，该循环将像素对齐的轮廓评判与零力重力平衡预检配对。经验证的世界编译为一个统一求解器，耦合刚体、铰接链、同维布料壳层和3D四面体弹性动力学，其模拟推演通过像素对齐的结构流为预训练视频扩散模型提供条件。在100个场景的单图像基准上，闭环执行将平衡验证的世界恢复率从单遍合成的0%提高到81%。受控本构消融显示，有限元布料中的局部角点位移和面外褶皱比匹配的刚性板代理大一个数量级以上。以模拟轨迹为视频扩散提供条件，将动态运动掩码重叠提高2×–5×，并在直接图像到视频模型失败的反事实力反向情况下保持运动方向。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为三维与定位，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 需核对传感器、标定、尺度与算力；重建画质和可用的定位精度属于不同指标。

items.title_en: AI for Biologists: The Knowledge Boundaries of Foundation Models in the Age of Agentic Systems
items.title_zh: 面向生物学家的AI：智能体系统时代基础模型的知识边界
items.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) is changing how biological research is done. Biological foundation models trained on millions of nucleotides, protein, and single-cell measurements predict protein structures, mutation effects, and cellular responses to genetic perturbations. Agentic systems, AI assistants built on large language models, can run multistep analyses from plain-language requests and increasingly call foundation models as tools. Yet it is often unclear when these models' outputs can be trusted. We frame this as a model's knowledge boundary: the range of inputs, tasks, and conditions over which its outputs are reliable. This review explains how foundation models are built and proposes that five design elements (data, architecture, training scheme, evaluation scheme, and post-analysis) define this boundary. We examine evidence on where current models succeed or fail and present standardized descriptions of model limits so that researchers, and the agents acting for them, can use these tools reliably.
items.abstract_zh: 人工智能（AI）正在改变生物学研究的方式。基于数百万核苷酸、蛋白质和单细胞测量训练的生物基础模型可预测蛋白质结构、突变效应以及细胞对遗传扰动的响应。智能体系统——构建于大语言模型之上的AI助手——能够根据自然语言请求运行多步骤分析，并越来越多地将基础模型作为工具调用。然而，这些模型的输出何时可信往往并不明确。我们将其表述为模型的知识边界：即其输出可靠所覆盖的输入、任务和条件范围。本综述解释基础模型如何构建，并提出五个设计要素（数据、架构、训练方案、评估方案和分析后处理）界定该边界。我们考察当前模型在何处成功或失败的证据，并提出模型局限的标准化描述，以便研究人员及其代为行动的智能体能够可靠地使用这些工具。

items.title_en: Multi-output neural network surrogate for double-pulse femtosecond optothermal control of thin silicon films on fused silica
items.title_zh: 用于熔融石英上薄硅膜双脉冲飞秒光热控制的多输出神经网络代理模型
items.abstract_en: We introduce a multi-output feedforward neural network surrogate trained on a coupled multiple-reflection and two-temperature model to map double-pulse femtosecond laser excitation (1030 nm) of crystalline silicon films on fused silica across film thicknesses (50-500 nm) and inter-pulse delays (0-10ps). Trained via Levenberg-Marquardt optimization on 2000 physical simulations, the dual-hidden-layer network ([40,30] neurons) simultaneously predicts six strongly coupled optothermal observables, peak electron temperature, peak lattice temperature, peak carrier density, minimum and maximum absorptivity and minimum refractive index achieving coefficients of determination R2 larger than 0.9998 across all targets. Evaluating a dense 200 by 200 design grid in milliseconds resolves pronounced thin-film interference fringes and carrier-induced index modulation, identifying an optimal optothermal coupling regime at d=156 nm and Dt=4.572 ps. This unified machine-learning workflow eliminates computationally expensive multi-physics runtime bottlenecks for real-time laser processing control and inverse photonic thin-film design.
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种多输出前馈神经网络代理模型，基于耦合多次反射与双温模型训练，用于映射熔融石英上晶体硅膜的双脉冲飞秒激光激发（1030 nm），覆盖膜厚（50–500 nm）和脉冲间隔（0–10 ps）。该双隐藏层网络（[40,30] 个神经元）通过 Levenberg-Marquardt 优化在 2000 次物理模拟上训练，可同时预测六个强耦合的光热可观测量：峰值电子温度、峰值晶格温度、峰值载流子密度、最小和最大吸收率以及最小折射率，所有目标上的决定系数 R² 均大于 0.9998。在毫秒级时间内评估 200×200 的密集设计网格，可解析显著的薄膜干涉条纹和载流子诱导的折射率调制，并识别出 d=156 nm、Dt=4.572 ps 时的最优光热耦合区间。这一统一的机器学习工作流消除了计算昂贵的多物理场运行时瓶颈，可用于实时激光加工控制和逆向光子薄膜设计。

items.title_en: artist: A Python package for differentiable ray tracing and gradient-based optimization of solar tower power plant operation
items.title_zh: artist：用于太阳能塔式电站运行的可微射线追踪与基于梯度优化的 Python 包
items.abstract_en: Solar tower power plants provide dispatchable, renewable energy by concentrating sunlight with thousands of mirrors, called heliostats, onto a central receiver. Efficient operation requires accurate modeling of the optical path from each heliostat to the receiver and compensation for manufacturing imperfections, kinematic misalignment, and material degradation that distort the flux distribution. Conventional ray tracers predict the flux from an assumed plant model but are limited to forward simulation. They cannot recover unknown plant parameters from measured flux nor directly optimize plant operation. We present artist, an open-source, FAIR4RS-compliant Python package implementing a fully differentiable digital twin of solar tower power plants. By making the optical pipeline, comprising heliostat surface representation, kinematics, blocking, and ray tracing, end to end differentiable, artist turns the digital twin from a passive forward model into an active physics-based tool for inverse modeling and data-driven optimization. The resulting gradient-based framework unifies tasks usually handled by separate solutions, such as reconstructing heliostat surfaces and kinematics from operational flux images without costly deflectometry, predicting irradiance at the receiver, and optimizing aim points to realize a desired receiver flux density distribution. Built on PyTorch, artist scales to real plants through GPU acceleration, a structure-of-arrays memory layout, and nested data parallelism. It interfaces with open data sources such as the PAINT database. We describe the software architecture, physical models, and optimization framework, and demonstrate the workflow on representative tasks. By integrating modeling, prediction, and optimization into a single open, interpretable package, artist provides a principled foundation for data-driven research toward autonomous solar tower operation.
items.abstract_zh: 太阳能塔式电站通过数千面称为定日镜的镜子将阳光聚集到中央接收器上，提供可调度的可再生能源。高效运行需要准确建模从每面定日镜到接收器的光路，并补偿制造缺陷、运动学失准和材料退化所造成的通量分布畸变。传统射线追踪器从假设的电站模型预测通量，但局限于前向仿真。它们无法从测量通量中恢复未知的电站参数，也无法直接优化电站运行。我们提出 artist，这是一个开源、符合 FAIR4RS 的 Python 包，实现了太阳能塔式电站的全可微数字孪生。通过使光学管线——包括定日镜表面表示、运动学、遮挡和射线追踪——端到端可微，artist 将数字孪生从被动的前向模型转变为用于逆向建模和数据驱动优化的主动的基于物理的工具。由此得到的基于梯度的框架统一了通常由不同方案处理的任务，例如无需昂贵的偏折测量即可从运行通量图像重建定日镜表面和运动学、预测接收器处的辐照度，以及优化瞄准点以实现所需的接收器通量密度分布。artist 基于 PyTorch 构建，通过 GPU 加速、数组结构（structure-of-arrays）内存布局和嵌套数据并行扩展到真实电站。它可与 PAINT 数据库等开放数据源对接。我们描述该软件的架构、物理模型和优化框架，并在代表性任务上演示其工作流。通过将建模、预测和优化集成到一个开放、可解释的单一软件包中，artist 为面向自主太阳能塔式运行的数据驱动研究提供了有原则的基础。

items.title_en: CuRSE-Bench: A Benchmark for Probing Cultural Blind Spots in Text-to-Image Safety Evaluation
items.title_zh: CuRSE-Bench：用于探查文本到图像安全评估中文化盲点的基准
items.abstract_en: Text-to-image (T2I) safety evaluation typically assigns each prompt or image a single culture-blind harm label, so content that is harmful only within a particular culture can pass as benign. We introduce CultureCraft, an agentic framework that constructs T2I prompts that appear benign under a general-purpose rubric yet carry a latent harmful meaning in a target culture, and use it to build CuRSE-Bench: 10,709 culture-specific prompts and 2,648 culture-general controls over six regions and ten harm axes, each drawn from a predefined knowledge base of documented harm vectors and traceable to at least two independent sources. Scoring every prompt under six region persona judges and a paired culture-blind judge, we find that the culture-blind judge under-rates culture-specific latent harm while matching the persona judges on the controls. Each persona judge, in turn, chiefly decodes its own region's latent harm under our instrument: a selective cultural blind spot that persists in deployed moderators.
items.abstract_zh: 文本到图像（T2I）安全评估通常为每个提示或图像分配单一的文化盲有害标签，因此仅在特定文化中有害的内容可能被视为良性而通过。我们提出 CultureCraft，这是一个智能体框架，用于构建在通用规则下看似良性、但在目标文化中携带潜在有害含义的 T2I 提示，并用它构建 CuRSE-Bench：覆盖六个地区和十个危害轴的 10,709 个文化特定提示和 2,648 个文化通用对照，每个均来自记录在案的有害向量预定义知识库，并可追溯到至少两个独立来源。在六个地区角色评审员和一个配对的文化盲评审员下对每个提示评分，我们发现文化盲评审员会低估文化特定的潜在危害，而在对照项上与角色评审员一致。反过来，每个角色评审员在我们的工具下主要解码其本地区的潜在危害：一种选择性的文化盲点，且在已部署的审核器中持续存在。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为生成与多模态，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: OrthoMark: Place Recognition with Point-Anchored Orthographic Height Mark
items.title_zh: OrthoMark：基于点锚定正交高度标记的地点识别
items.abstract_en: LiDAR place recognition provides the loop closures of Simultaneous Localization and Mapping(SLAM). Perspective from Z-axis, a gravity-aligned scan is an orthographic map of the scene, and a revisit from another position and heading moves this map rigidly in the plane, a motion that a polar Fourier spectrum ignores and phase correlation recovers. Along the vertical, the heights of the returns describe the structures, but which heights are observed depends on the range, because the sensor's vertical field of view cuts nearby structures low; height thus misleads a global key, yet is decisive once two scans are aligned and compared cell by cell where they overlap. We present \method, a training-free method built on one principle: two LiDAR scans can only be compared through features computed from the same geometric surfaces in both scans. \method retrieves candidates with a translation- and rotation-invariant polar spectrum of the bird's-eye view (BEV), 1.9,KB per keyframe, and verifies each candidate by estimating its planar pose through phase correlation and scoring it with \emph{point-anchored height columns}: every BEV cell keeps a 16-bit mask of the heights of its own returns; within a session, the score is weighted by the expected overlap of the two scans' sensing ranges, computed from their distance. We show that this vertical link pays off in verification but hurts in retrieval, where what a height slice contains depends on the range to the structure. For single robot, \method has the highest AP of the training-free methods without 3D registration on the KITTI development sequences; across robots, on all multi-robot sequences, it matches or exceeds RING++ at 1/350 of its descriptor size and closes more inter-robot loops than the learned BEVPlace++ on all tests.
items.abstract_zh: LiDAR 地点识别为同步定位与建图（SLAM）提供回环闭合。从 Z 轴视角看，重力对齐的扫描是场景的正交地图，而从另一位置和航向重访会使该地图在平面内刚性移动；极坐标傅里叶谱会忽略这种运动，而相位相关可将其恢复。在垂直方向上，回波的高度描述结构，但观测到哪些高度取决于距离，因为传感器的垂直视场会将近处结构截得很低；因此高度会误导全局关键帧，但一旦两次扫描对齐并在重叠区域逐单元比较，高度就具有决定性。我们提出 OrthoMark，这是一种无需训练的方法，基于一个原则：两次 LiDAR 扫描只能通过由两次扫描中相同几何表面计算出的特征进行比较。OrthoMark 使用鸟瞰图（BEV）的平移和旋转不变极坐标谱检索候选，每个关键帧 1.9 KB，并通过相位相关估计每个候选的平面位姿，再用点锚定高度列对其进行评分来验证：每个 BEV 单元保留其自身回波高度的 16 位掩码；在一次会话内，分数由两次扫描感知范围的预期重叠加权，该重叠由其距离计算。我们表明，这种垂直联系在验证中有益，但在检索中有害，因为高度切片包含的内容取决于到结构的距离。对于单机器人，在 KITTI 开发序列上，OrthoMark 在不进行 3D 配准的无需训练方法中具有最高 AP；跨机器人时，在所有多机器人序列上，它以 1/350 的描述子大小达到或超过 RING++，并在所有测试中比学习到的 BEVPlace++ 闭合更多机器人间回环。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为三维与定位，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: From Images to Grounded Edits: A Real-World Benchmark for Chinese Grammatical Error Correction in Handwritten Essays
items.title_zh: 从图像到定位编辑：面向手写作文中文语法纠错的真实世界基准
items.abstract_en: Chinese Grammatical Error Correction (CGEC) is typically formulated as a text-to-text problem. While suitable for digital texts, this formulation falls short in real-world K-12 education, where AI-assisted corrections are expected directly on essay images, which are primarily handwritten and exhibit many irregularities. To bridge this gap, we introduce Grounded Chinese Grammatical Error Correction (G-CGEC), an image-to-grounded-edit task requiring systems to predict both corrections and their positions on essay images. We propose G-CGEC-Eval, a benchmark comprising real-world images of K-12 Chinese essays with fine-grained annotations. For evaluation, we adapt IoU-based metrics from object detection and propose a more tolerant alternative based on center-distance matching. Using this benchmark, we evaluate open-source and proprietary vision-language models under a direct single-pass setting, as well as settings with auxiliary components (OCR and character grounding) coordinated via pipelining or agentic harnessing. Results show that even top-tier proprietary models perform surprisingly poorly in the single-pass setting, while pipelining and agentic harnessing yield meaningful improvements. Notably, an error-type-based multi-agent workflow achieves the best performance, establishing it as the strongest baseline for future G-CGEC research. Through ablations and fine-grained analysis, we find the task remains far from solved, with linguistic error discovery and character-level grounding as the primary bottlenecks. This underscores the need for models that better integrate visual perception with linguistic reasoning and visual grounding.
items.abstract_zh: 中文语法纠错（CGEC）通常被表述为文本到文本问题。虽然这适用于数字文本，但这种表述在真实世界的 K-12 教育中并不够用，因为 AI 辅助纠错被期望直接作用于作文图像，而这些图像主要是手写的，并表现出许多不规则性。为弥合这一差距，我们引入基于定位的中文语法纠错（G-CGEC），这是一个图像到定位编辑的任务，要求系统同时预测纠错内容及其在作文图像上的位置。我们提出 G-CGEC-Eval，一个包含真实世界 K-12 中文作文图像及细粒度标注的基准。在评估方面，我们改编了目标检测中基于 IoU 的指标，并提出了一种基于中心距离匹配、更宽容的替代指标。利用该基准，我们在直接单次通过的设置下，以及在通过流水线或智能体化封装协调辅助组件（OCR 和字符定位）的设置下，评估了开源和专有视觉语言模型。结果表明，即使顶级专有模型在单次通过设置下也表现得出奇地差，而流水线和智能体化封装带来了有意义的改进。值得注意的是，基于错误类型的多智能体工作流取得了最佳性能，使其成为未来 G-CGEC 研究的最强基线。通过消融和细粒度分析，我们发现该任务仍远未解决，语言错误发现和字符级定位是主要瓶颈。这凸显了需要更好地整合视觉感知与语言推理及视觉定位的模型。

items.title_en: In-context learning predicts clinical endpoints from bulk transcriptomes across diseases and platforms
items.title_zh: 上下文学习可从跨疾病和平台的批量转录组预测临床终点
items.abstract_en: Bulk transcriptomes carry information on diagnosis, treatment response and survival, but clinical cohorts are small, and each gets a model of its own that often fails in the next cohort. Here we present PRTS, a 220-million-parameter model that reads a labelled cohort as context and predicts binary, multiclass, continuous or survival endpoints for new samples from whole transcriptomes, without per-cohort training. PRTS was pretrained on 6.0 million tasks generated from public RNA-seq profiles. On 175 held-out tasks and 44 tasks from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA), it had the highest mean predictive accuracy, narrowly ahead of TabPFN v3.5, the strongest pre-specified comparator. The lead came from within-cohort prediction and, on TCGA, mainly from survival tasks; across cohorts and at unseen sites, PRTS was level with the strongest tabular models while running more than twice as fast as TabPFN v3.5. The same weights transfer labels to new cohorts from public references, forecast accuracy from pilots, flag suspect labels and attribute predictions to genes. We release the prior, the pretraining code and the model with its weights, together with RealBulk, a collection of 1,160 curated public cohorts, and its benchmark.
items.abstract_zh: 批量转录组携带诊断、治疗反应和生存信息，但临床队列规模小，且每个队列各自建立模型，往往在下一个队列中失效。在此，我们提出 PRTS，这是一个 2.2 亿参数模型，它读取带标签队列作为上下文，并从全转录组为新样本预测二分类、多分类、连续或生存终点，无需按队列训练。PRTS 在由公开 RNA-seq 图谱生成的 600 万个任务上预训练。在 175 个留出任务和来自癌症基因组图谱（TCGA）的 44 个任务上，它取得了最高的平均预测准确率，略微领先于 TabPFN v3.5 这一最强预设比较器。领先主要来自队列内预测，而在 TCGA 上主要来自生存任务；跨队列和在未见位点时，PRTS 与最强表格模型持平，同时运行速度超过 TabPFN v3.5 的两倍。相同权重可将标签从公开参考转移到新队列、根据试点预测准确率、标记可疑标签，并将预测归因于基因。我们发布先验、预训练代码及模型和权重，以及 RealBulk——一个包含 1,160 个精选公开队列的集合及其基准。

items.title_en: Machine Learning the $GW$ Self-Energy Operator for Real Materials
items.title_zh: 面向真实材料的 $GW$ 自能算子机器学习
items.abstract_en: Machine learning of $GW$ in solids has largely focused on prediction of scalar quasiparticle energy corrections. Here, we introduce a phase-aware many-body transformer that predicts the full $\mathbf{k}$-resolved complex self-energy matrix. As a proof of principle, we apply the model to predict quasiparticle energies before and after diagonalization of the quasiparticle Hamiltonian, obtaining a test set mean absolute error (MAE) of 29 meV for a dataset of 1745 2D materials in the static COHSEX approximation and 60 meV for a more limited dataset of 433 materials calculated within a plasmon-pole model. COHSEX pretraining followed by finetuning reduces this MAE to 42 meV. The predicted matrices also accurately reproduce QP wavefunctions.
items.abstract_zh: 固体中 $GW$ 的机器学习主要集中于预测标量准粒子能量修正。在此，我们引入一种相位感知的多体 Transformer，用于预测完整的 $\mathbf{k}$ 分辨复自能矩阵。作为原理验证，我们应用该模型预测准粒子哈密顿量对角化前后的准粒子能量，在静态 COHSEX 近似下对 1745 种二维材料的数据集取得测试集平均绝对误差（MAE）29 meV，在等离激元极点模型下对更有限的 433 种材料数据集取得 60 meV。先进行 COHSEX 预训练再微调可将该 MAE 降至 42 meV。预测矩阵还能准确重现 QP 波函数。

items.title_en: DNA: A Double-Helix Hierarchical Deep Interaction Network Architecture for Industrial Digital Twin
items.title_zh: DNA：一种面向工业数字孪生的双螺旋分层深度交互网络架构
items.abstract_en: High-fidelity modeling is fundamental to industrial digital twin, yet a trade-off persists between the physical transparency of mechanistic models and the superior predictive power of data-driven approaches. Existing hybrid methods often fail to bridge this gap, suffering from shallow integration and rigid one-shot modeling strategies that struggle with complex industrial systems. To address these issues, we propose a \textbf{Double-Helix Hierarchical Deep Interaction Network Architecture (DNA)}. Inspired by the double-helix structure of biological \textit{DNA}, our architecture intertwines mechanistic and data-driven modeling strands through two novel interaction strategies, forming a symbiotic architecture in which the two strands mutually enhance predictive capability. Furthermore, the hierarchical structure of DNA allows it to model complex systems in a multi-stage manner through two tailored deep learning frameworks. We evaluate the proposed approach on two distinct industrial systems, where DNA achieves reductions in MAE of 3.704\% and 3.175\%, respectively, compared to the strongest baseline. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of DNA and suggest its potential to provide new insights for the development of industrial digital twins.
items.abstract_zh: 高保真建模是工业数字孪生的基础，但机理模型的物理透明性与数据驱动方法更优的预测能力之间始终存在权衡。现有混合方法往往无法弥合这一差距，受限于浅层集成和僵化的一次性建模策略，难以应对复杂工业系统。为解决这些问题，我们提出一种双螺旋分层深度交互网络架构（DNA）。受生物DNA双螺旋结构启发，我们的架构通过两种新颖的交互策略将机理建模链与数据驱动建模链交织在一起，形成一种共生架构，其中两条链相互增强预测能力。此外，DNA的分层结构使其能够通过两个量身定制的深度学习框架以多阶段方式对复杂系统建模。我们在两个不同的工业系统上评估所提方法，与最强基线相比，DNA分别将MAE降低3.704%和3.175%。这些结果证明了DNA的有效性，并表明其有望为工业数字孪生的发展提供新的见解。

recommendation.reason_zh: 研究主题为学习与优化，来源提供摘要供核对方法和实验。 依据原始发表时间列入近一年研究；尚不据此声称已有长期影响。

items.title_en: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB: An Open and Efficient Small Language Model for Fast Conversational Agents
items.title_zh: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB：面向快速对话代理的开放高效小型语言模型
items.abstract_en: We introduce Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB, an open and efficient small language model further post-trained from Gemma-4-E4B-it and optimized for speed and intelligence per GB of memory used for fast conversational agents. The model carries forward Gemma's strong conversational capabilities and further improves multi-turn tool use, instruction following, and input grounding for fast, local voice/device assistants, interactive personas, and embedded/Edge interfaces. The model combines natural conversation with multi-turn agentic capabilities to power voice/device assistants, interactive characters and robotic/IoT interfaces running on GeForce RTX, Jetson, and RTX/DGX Spark. Experiments on 21 benchmarks show that Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB achieves the highest average accuracy while generating the fewest output tokens in both reasoning and non-reasoning modes, compared with Gemma-4-E4B-it and Qwen3.5-4B. The model is released with a DFlash drafter. With DFlash, Bolt E4B achieves $2.74\times$ the per-user decode speed of inference without speculative decoding at concurrency~1, and $1.21\times$ the generation throughput of Gemma-4-E4B-it with MTP at batch size 1.
items.abstract_zh: 我们介绍 Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB，这是一个开放且高效的小型语言模型，基于 Gemma-4-E4B-it 进一步后训练，并针对快速对话代理所用的每 GB 内存的速度和智能进行优化。该模型继承了 Gemma 强大的对话能力，并进一步改进了多轮工具使用、指令遵循和输入接地，适用于快速本地语音/设备助手、交互式角色和嵌入式/边缘接口。该模型将自然对话与多轮代理能力相结合，为运行在 GeForce RTX、Jetson 和 RTX/DGX Spark 上的语音/设备助手、交互式角色和机器人/IoT 接口提供支持。在21个基准上的实验表明，与 Gemma-4-E4B-it 和 Qwen3.5-4B 相比，Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB 在推理和非推理模式下均实现了最高平均准确率，同时生成输出 token 最少。该模型随 DFlash drafter 发布。借助 DFlash，在并发度为1时，Bolt E4B 的每用户解码速度达到不使用推测解码推理的2.74倍，并且在批大小为1时，其生成吞吐量达到使用 MTP 的 Gemma-4-E4B-it 的1.21倍。

items.title_en: Stochastic Self-Distillation for Flow-Based Vision-Language-Action Models
items.title_zh: 面向基于流的视觉-语言-动作模型的随机自蒸馏
items.abstract_en: Flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) models achieve strong performance in robotics through imitation learning, yet fine-tuning them with on-policy reinforcement learning (RL) is limited. In group-based RL methods like Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), every rollout step requires multi-step ODE integration, and the sampler's limited stochasticity leads to rollout groups with low variance. We propose VLA-SSD, which addresses both high inference latency and limited stochasticity. In particular, our method self-distills a pretrained flow-matching action head into a stochastic one-step policy by conditioning a single-jump generator on a Brownian path. We derive a conditional action density via our stochastic one-step policy, enabling efficient post-training via likelihood-ratio RL algorithms. We show that distilling VLA-SSD from the $π_0$ VLA reduces the action head's forward-pass time by a factor of 7.7, at the cost of a 5.5% relative decrease in the success rate on the LIBERO benchmark. However, by leveraging the increased sample diversity of VLA-SSD during group generation, post-training a $π_{0.5}$ VLA using GRPO yields a 20.6% relative improvement.
items.abstract_zh: 基于流的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过模仿学习在机器人领域取得强性能，但使用在线策略强化学习（RL）对其进行微调仍受限。在 Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）等基于组的RL方法中，每个 rollout 步骤都需要多步 ODE 积分，而采样器的有限随机性导致 rollout 组方差较低。我们提出 VLA-SSD，同时解决高推理延迟和有限随机性问题。具体而言，我们的方法通过将单跳生成器以布朗路径为条件，将预训练的流匹配动作头自蒸馏为随机一步策略。我们通过随机一步策略推导条件动作密度，从而能够通过似然比 RL 算法进行高效后训练。我们表明，从 π0 VLA 蒸馏 VLA-SSD 可将动作头的前向传播时间减少7.7倍，代价是在 LIBERO 基准上的成功率相对下降5.5%。然而，通过利用 VLA-SSD 在组生成过程中增加的样本多样性，使用 GRPO 对 π0.5 VLA 进行后训练可带来20.6%的相对提升。

items.title_en: Can Large Language Models Optimize Pretrained Neural Network Weights? A Multi-Phase Empirical Evaluation of Gradient-Free Editing in YOLO26 Object Detection
items.title_zh: 大型语言模型能否优化预训练神经网络权重？YOLO26目标检测中无梯度编辑的多阶段实证评估
items.abstract_en: Direct weight editing offers a gradient-free alternative to fine-tuning pretrained detectors, but its generalization and the value of large language model (LLM) guidance remain uncertain. We evaluate five experimental phases using YOLO26 models and MS COCO, comparing deterministic scaling, random perturbations, differential evolution, CMA-ES, structured interventions, real local-LLM proposals, failure-aware guidance, and hybrid LLM-CMA-ES against a matched random-policy control. Optimization uses native Ultralytics mAP50-95 on 1,000 COCO Val2017 images; selected candidates are assessed on a disjoint, previously examined 1,500-image subset, with COCO API AP50-95 reported separately where available. Increasing the CMA-ES budget from 8 to 250 evaluations raised development gains from +0.11 to +0.28 percentage points, while selection changes remained negative (-0.03 to -0.12 points); the 250-evaluation result uses one seed. The hybrid LLM approach showed no statistically established advantage over random-policy guidance (p = 0.612, 0.369, and 0.694 at budgets 8, 25, and 50). Five-seed YOLO26m replication yielded a COCO API AP difference of +0.004 points (95% CI: -0.026 to +0.034). Of 225 archived LLM proposals, 53 satisfy the final strict schema; early tensor-level execution cannot be fully verified. Genuine LLM-mediated weight editing is feasible, but the tested approaches did not demonstrate consistent transfer beyond the development subset or a measurable LLM advantage.
items.abstract_zh: 直接权重编辑为微调预训练检测器提供了一种无梯度替代方案，但其泛化性以及大型语言模型（LLM）指导的价值仍不确定。我们使用YOLO26模型和MS COCO评估五个实验阶段，将确定性缩放、随机扰动、差分进化、CMA-ES、结构化干预、真实本地LLM提议、失败感知指导以及混合LLM-CMA-ES与匹配的随机策略对照进行比较。优化使用原生Ultralytics mAP50-95，在1,000张COCO Val2017图像上进行；入选候选在一个不相交、此前已检查的1,500张图像子集上评估，并在可获得时单独报告COCO API AP50-95。将CMA-ES预算从8次评估增加到250次评估，使开发集增益从+0.11个百分点提高到+0.28个百分点，而选择变化仍为负值（-0.03至-0.12个百分点）；250次评估的结果使用一个随机种子。混合LLM方法未显示出相对于随机策略指导的统计学确立优势（预算8、25和50时p = 0.612、0.369和0.694）。五种子YOLO26m重复实验得到COCO API AP差异为+0.004个百分点（95% CI：-0.026至+0.034）。在225个存档LLM提议中，53个满足最终严格模式；早期张量级执行无法完全验证。真正的LLM介导权重编辑是可行的，但所测试方法未证明在开发子集之外具有一致迁移性或可测量的LLM优势。

items.title_en: Connectivity from activity in spiking neural networks
items.title_zh: 脉冲神经网络中由活动推断连接性
items.abstract_en: We show that a wide range of recurrent neural network models obey a simple set of equations tying synaptic connectivity and single-cell response properties to neural correlations. Our modeling framework considers networks in a stationary, asynchronous state and contains a broad class of synaptic filters, spiking nonlinearities, and random-plus-structured connectivity. The resulting equations naturally decompose into contributions from monosynaptic, disynaptic, and higher order paths through the network. We leverage this decomposition to express the effective monosynaptic connection between two neurons in terms of experimentally measurable statistics of the activity, and in particular, their high-frequency correlations. In this way, we show that it is possible to recover network connectivity from neural activity.
items.abstract_zh: 我们表明，广泛的循环神经网络模型服从一组简单方程，这些方程将突触连接性和单细胞响应特性与神经相关性联系起来。我们的建模框架考虑处于平稳异步状态的网络，并包含一大类突触滤波器、脉冲非线性以及随机加结构化连接。所得方程自然分解为来自网络中的单突触、双突触和更高阶路径的贡献。我们利用这种分解，将两个神经元之间的有效单突触连接表示为活动（特别是其高频相关性）的实验可测量统计量。通过这种方式，我们表明可以从神经活动恢复网络连接性。
